article_content: Johnny Ruffo, an Australian television star and singer, has died from brain cancer at the age of 35, according to the BBC. He passed away on November 3, surrounded by loved ones, his family said in a statement posted to his Instagram account. “He battled all the way to the end and fought as hard as he could,” the statement read. “Such a beautiful soul with so much more to give.” Ruffo rose to fame on the reality show X Factor Australia before joining the soap opera Home and Away. After being diagnosed with brain cancer in 2017, he became an active fundraiser and advocate for brain cancer awareness in Australia. Former X Factor host and Spice Girl Mel B was among those who sent condolences to his family. Dannii Minogue wrote on Instagram: “The cheekiest chap. His voice, smile and dancing feet will be missed by so many.” Ruffo was born in Perth, Western Australia. He joined the X Factor cast in its third season in 2011 and went on to release several singles, win a season of Australia’s Dancing with the Stars, and star as Chris Harrington on Home and Away for three years. Ruffo's cancer initially went into remission after two years of treatment, but it returned in 2020. He is survived by his partner, Tahnee Sims.

article_content: Australia has approved the resumption of aerial shooting of wild horses in Kosciuszko National Park, one of the country's largest national parks. Authorities describe this controversial measure as essential for protecting native wildlife. Currently, about 19,000 wild horses—known as 'brumbies'—roam Kosciuszko National Park. New South Wales officials plan to reduce their numbers to 3,000 by mid-2027. The national park already uses ground-based methods such as trapping, re-homing, and ground shooting, but New South Wales Environment Minister Penny Sharpe states these efforts are not enough. 'Threatened native species are in danger of extinction and the entire ecosystem is under threat. We must take action,' she said. 'This was not an easy decision—no one wants to kill wild horses,' she added. Aerial shooting, conducted from helicopters, was previously used briefly in 2000, when more than 600 horses were shot in three days, but intense public backlash led to a ban of the method. Opponents of the cull argue that brumbies are a symbol of Australia's heritage, recalling the era of resilient stockmen and women in the Snowy Mountains. Brumbies are famously celebrated in the poetry of Banjo Paterson, who described them as 'wild, unhandled' creatures roaming the mountains. The rugby team in Canberra, the national capital, is also named after the animal. Conversely, conservationists view brumbies as invasive pests, saying they destroy native plants by grazing and trampling, increase soil erosion, foul waterholes, and compete with native animals for resources. ‘The unique and complex ecosystems of the Australian Alps have been trampled for too long,’ said Jacqui Mumford, chief executive of the Nature Conservation Council. She asserts that brumbies' activities have damaged at least 25 threatened alpine plant species and 14 threatened animal species, including the corroboree frog, the broad-toothed rat, and rare alpine orchids.

article_content: Brazil delivered a commanding 4-0 win over Panama in a World Cup warm-up at Serra Dourada stadium. Neymar, representing Barcelona, was outstanding, opening the scoring with an excellent free-kick and showcasing remarkable skills throughout the match. Managed by Luiz Felipe Scolari, Brazil has only one more game before starting their World Cup campaign at home. Goalkeeper Julio Cesar, still associated with Queens Park Rangers, was reliable and made a standout save after slipping on the poor pitch, diverting a header over the bar. He remained assured and took on captain duties when David Luiz was substituted. Oscar had a subdued performance and was overshadowed by Neymar. Played mostly on the left rather than his preferred central position, he was replaced by Willian early in the second half due to Scolari’s tactical adjustments. This may affect Oscar's starting place in upcoming matches. Ramires found the start of the match challenging as Panama started strongly, but he improved later and contributed energy to the midfield. He was substituted at half-time for Hernanes, after which Brazil became more composed. Willian’s substitution made a considerable difference, providing width and helping Neymar operate centrally. Willian scored Brazil’s fourth goal and almost had two assists with precise crosses. His performance could earn him a starting spot in the World Cup opener. David Luiz, captaining the side, received a yellow card for a rash challenge but otherwise played well, including making a key pass in Hulk’s goal build-up. article_content: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has registered a case under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) against Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Ravindra Waikar, his wife Manisha Waikar, and others, over the alleged construction of a luxury hotel in Jogeshwari in violation of an agreement with the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC). Waikar and five others were previously booked by the Mumbai Police’s Economic Offences Wing (EOW) last month. The ED's money laundering case is based on the FIR filed by the EOW. An ED source confirmed that an Enforcement Case Information Report (ECIR) was registered against Waikar and several others about a week ago, with suspects possibly being called for questioning soon. The central agency will investigate the money laundering aspect, while the police are handling the criminal investigation. In September, Waikar and other accused were charged by the EOW with criminal breach of trust, cheating, dishonestly inducing delivery of property, and criminal conspiracy. Last week, Waikar was questioned by EOW officers. His wife has also been summoned by the police. The FIR originated from a complaint by BMC sub-engineer Santosh Mandavkar at the Azad Maidan police station, after which the case was transferred to the EOW. According to the EOW’s FIR, Waikar entered into a contract with the BMC after receiving permission to operate a sports facility on the Jogeshwari plot. The permission had been granted during the tenure of the Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA) government. Earlier this year, Waikar received a notice for using the plot—originally reserved for a public garden—to construct a hotel. Others booked in the case include business partners Aasoo Nehlanai, Raj Lalchandani, the late Prithpalsingh Bindra, and architect Arun Dubey. A police officer stated that no arrests have been made in the case so far. Waikar was also questioned by the EOW in August. BJP leader Kirit Somaiya had accused Waikar of being involved in a Rs 500 crore scam, claims which Waikar denies. Waikar has stated that he has provided all evidence to the EOW to disprove the BJP’s allegations. “My statement has been recorded, and I have submitted details proving that I followed all rules and laws for the project,” Waikar said in August.

Waikar miwah lima sane lian sampun kasuratang olih Economic Offences Wing (EOW) Polisi Mumbai rauh warsa puniki. Kasus money laundering ring ED nyarengin dasar FIR sane kadadosang olih EOW. Sumber ring ED nglaksanayang indik indik panglimakan Enforcement Case Information Report (ECIR) ring Waikar miwah sane lian semeng warsa puniki, indik terduga pinaka kabuatin ajengan indik pacang kadadosang ajengan ring ida. Ijin punika kabidabdab ring mangda dadi pemerintah Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA). Rauh warsa puniki, Waikar nampi surat peringatan indik ngawagunin plot sane sebeten dados taman umum ring hotel. article_content: Southampton captain Adam Lallana has admitted he hopes to play at the highest level, amid reported interest from Liverpool. Premier League contenders Liverpool are expected to complete a £20 million transfer for Lallana as soon as next week. Lallana says he faces a tough decision because he wants the opportunity to play Champions League football. He reflected on getting emotional at the club's awards night due to the significance of his impending decision. 'I'm ambitious. I want to play in the Champions League one day and compete for the Premier League title,' Lallana told the club's matchday programme before Southampton's match against Manchester United. 'I got emotional at the awards because it's been a journey I could never have imagined, but I'm not saying this is the end by any means. Big decisions are coming in the summer, and maybe it all hit home while I was talking.' 'Every fan can see the big potential in our team, and we have players who are capable of playing at a higher level.' Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers is aiming to add world-class starters to his squad this summer.

A convoy delivering essential medical supplies to health facilities in Gaza City came under fire, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The attack damaged two trucks and left one driver with minor injuries. The ICRC stated that the convoy was carrying lifesaving medical supplies to several health centers, including Al Quds hospital of the Palestinian Red Crescent Society. In response to the incident, the ICRC expressed deep concern and reminded all parties involved in the conflict of their responsibilities under international humanitarian law to respect and protect humanitarian workers at all times. The ICRC did not specify the source of the gunfire.

Following the attack, the convoy changed its route and successfully delivered medical supplies to al-Shifa Hospital. The convoy also accompanied six ambulances transporting critically wounded patients to the Rafah crossing, enabling them to leave Gaza for medical care. William Schomburg, head of the ICRC sub-delegation in Gaza, emphasized that such attacks create unsafe conditions for aid personnel and reaffirmed the legal obligation to ensure aid can reach medical facilities.

The ICRC, a neutral organization based in Geneva, has assisted in patient transport and the relocation of released captives out of Gaza. Gaza’s health officials report that since October 7, more than 10,000 Palestinians have been killed, around 40% of whom are children. The United Nations estimates that nearly two-thirds of Gaza’s 2.3 million residents are internally displaced, with thousands seeking shelter in hospitals and makeshift accommodations. Many hospitals in the enclave have themselves come under attack and are struggling to operate due to severe shortages of fuel and medical supplies. The UN warns that health, sanitation, water, and food services in Gaza are nearing collapse.

ICRC bilang konvoinya ngirim pasokan medis penting ke beberapa pusat kesehatan, termasuk Rumah Sakit Al Quds milik Palestinian Red Crescent Society. article_content: A large brawl involving nearly 300 wedding guests broke out at a reception in Middletown Township, New Jersey. According to police, the party had been underway for several hours before the altercation began around 10:30 p.m. on Sunday. The fight started inside the Jacques Reception Center and spilled out onto the street. When officers arrived, they found many guests shoving and shouting at each other. Additional support was requested from neighboring police departments. Witnesses reported that some guests were urinating outside the venue. Sergeant William Colangelo and Patrolman Frank Mazza, who were working off-duty security at the event, tried to break up the fight. The situation escalated, with about 80 people initially involved, and eventually up to 300. Police attempted to control the scene as the crowd grew increasingly unmanageable, with fighting, yelling, and people refusing to re-enter the hall. Assistance arrived from Keansburg, Holmdel, and Hazlet police. Authorities decided to shut down the reception due to the disorder. It took around 45 minutes to clear the venue and restore order. The cause of the brawl remains unclear, and an investigation is ongoing. No injuries were reported. Two people were arrested: Jonathan Accardi, 32, from Oceanside, New York, for obstruction and disorderly conduct, and Emily George, 23, from Haledon, New Jersey, for disorderly conduct. Both have been released and are awaiting court proceedings.

article_content: Ed Miliband held a private meeting in his Commons office with the disgraced former Co-op Bank chairman, Reverend Paul Flowers, it was revealed last night. This disclosure raises questions about Miliband’s relationship with Flowers, who is under police investigation after being filmed apparently purchasing hard drugs, including crack cocaine and crystal meth. The Co-op announced a comprehensive review of the incident as Miliband faced scrutiny over appointing Flowers as a business adviser. Flowers reportedly had significant access to and influence within Labour’s leadership for years. Labour sources confirmed that Miliband personally selected Flowers to join his Business and Industry Advisory Group in 2010, and even invited him for a private meeting in his Commons office last year. Additionally, Flowers described Shadow Chancellor Ed Balls as a ‘political friend’ and claimed to have helped secure a £50,000 donation for Balls from the Co-op. Both Miliband and Balls deny a close relationship with Flowers, who was suspended from Labour for ‘bringing the party into disrepute.’ A spokesperson for Balls, one of 32 Labour MPs sponsored by the Co-op, stated that Balls has never met Flowers nor discussed the donation with him. The near-collapse of the Co-op Bank is embarrassing for Labour, given its long-standing ties to the organization. Last year, Miliband described the bank as ‘the future of banking’ in a speech at its headquarters. Several MPs, including Chris Leslie, Gareth Thomas, and Stephen Twigg, receive financial support from the Co-op. Labour’s Business and Industry Advisory Group was established by Miliband to provide advice on business policy. Flowers, one of 20 initial members, attended meetings in 2011 and 2012, though the group has since been replaced. Video footage shows Flowers counting £300 in £20 notes before reportedly handing over the money in a drug deal. The video and a series of incriminating texts were provided to The Mail on Sunday by Stuart Davies, who said he was ‘disgusted by the hypocrisy.’ Asked about the position, Miliband replied, 'He was involved in the Co-op and that is no longer the case. I think we will leave it there. You appoint people from a range of backgrounds to look at a range of issues, and we have a range of business people working with us. The police are looking into the matter and I’m not going to comment on an ongoing investigation. Suffice to say that group no longer exists. We should let the police inquiry take its course.' Labour did not provide further detail about the March meeting with Flowers, describing it as a ‘private meeting.’ However, sources note it is not surprising that the Co-op Bank chair would be consulted on banking reform, given the organization’s historic ties to Labour. Earlier this month, Flowers told MPs that Balls played a role in supporting legislation for the Co-op Bank’s 2009 merger with Britannia Building Society, which negatively impacted the bank’s finances. The Co-op donated £750,000 to Labour in 2009, the year of the merger, and also provides Labour with a £1.3 million loan. A spokesperson for Balls, who spoke at this year’s Co-operative Party gala, said he had limited interaction with Flowers. 'Ed’s been to some events where Paul was present, but he’s never had a meeting or phone call with him. The Co-op Group donated £50,000 to the shadow chancellor’s office, which was declared in the normal way; Ed has never discussed the donation with Paul Flowers.' Flowers, now the first former Co-op Bank chairman to speak about these matters, confirmed Balls’ support for the 2009 merger, saying, 'Balls was particularly supportive of us—talking to us and encouraging us.' He clarified that Balls was Schools Minister at the time, not at the Treasury. The Treasury Select Committee also heard that Balls has had a close relationship with the Co-op Group, which gave his office £50,000 in donations last year.

article_content: The Indian finance ministry has instructed all departments and ministries to comply with the Department of Expenditure’s guidelines for issuing mobile phones, laptops, and similar devices to government officers. Existing internal policies that conflict with these guidelines must be withdrawn. In July, the Department of Expenditure issued guidelines stating that eligible central government officers can receive devices such as mobiles, laptops, tablets, phablets, notebooks, notepads, ultrabooks, and netbooks for official use. Officers of deputy secretary rank and above are eligible for these devices. For section officers and under secretaries, up to 50% of the sanctioned staff can be issued such electronics. The guidelines set a price cap of Rs 1 lakh plus taxes for standard devices. For devices with more than 40% Make-in-India components, the cap increases to Rs 1.3 lakh plus taxes. Officers may retain the devices for personal use after four years. Separately, the Income Tax Department is investigating the Indian operations of Apple, Google, and Amazon over possible non-payment of taxes, examining their transfer pricing practices since 2021. Additionally, Indian investors have become the leading buyers in Dubai’s real estate market. article_content: Two state troopers in New Jersey are being praised for their swift actions that saved a 13-year-old boy who began choking on a chicken nugget. The Estrada family was traveling through Trenton when Julian, who lives with hydrocephalus, suddenly became unable to breathe. His panicked family quickly flagged down Troopers Ruben Benavidez and James Hearne on Route 129. The incident, recorded on the troopers' dash cam, shows Trooper Hearne performing the Heimlich maneuver on Julian while Trooper Benavidez managed the surroundings — directing traffic, calling for backup, and calming the family in Spanish. Benavidez, only two weeks into the job, proved essential in supporting the rescue and communication. Julian’s mother, Maricruz Estrada, said they tried to save their son on their own but couldn’t, making the troopers' help a lifesaver. Because of Julian’s physical challenges, Trooper Hearne had to hold him upright while administering aid. The family calls the troopers their 'guardian angels' and credits them with saving Julian's life.

Benavidez sane ajeng makarya, prasida pikayunin komunikasi miwah nyarengin kasampunang indik puniki. Andrew Moffat, assistant headteacher at Birmingham’s Chilwell Croft Academy, has resigned following complaints from parents opposed to lessons teaching acceptance of homosexuality. The concerns, largely from Muslim parents and some from Christian parents, centered on educational material—including Moffat’s book 'Challenging Homophobia in Primary Schools'—used to promote tolerance and inclusivity, with lesson plans featuring scenarios about gay families.

Moffat came out as gay during a school assembly, after which parents from different backgrounds voiced objections. Despite this, he stands by his approach, asserting it was the right choice for promoting understanding.

This case arises amid the Department for Education's ongoing investigations into several Birmingham schools regarding the 'Trojan Horse' plot—allegations that some were seeking to impose strict religious standards within secular schools. While schools like Park View Academy face allegations of promoting extremist figures and enforcing religious practices, Chilwell Croft Academy clarified that its situation is unrelated to the broader investigations.

Educational leaders are divided: Liam Nolan has expressed strong support for Moffat’s work in relationship education, calling his resignation shocking; meanwhile, Chris McGovern of the Campaign for Real Education highlights the need for parental notification and the right to opt out of materials on religious grounds. The academy added that the contested resource books were only used with older students to explore diverse family relationships, and that objections came primarily from a minority of parents motivated by religious beliefs. Moffat has since taken up a teaching position outside Birmingham.

Keluhane punika utamane rauh saking orang tua beragama Muslim lan indik indik saking krama Kristen, mewah dados ring materi pelajaran salah satunya buku Moffat 'Challenging Homophobia in Primary Schools' sane ngajengang toleransi miwah inklusivitas ring siswa, ngantosang ring rencana pelajaran sane ngemolihang contoh pasemetonan keluarge gay.

Moffat medunang status dados gay ring upacara sekolah, wantah punika wenten orang tua saking daweg komunitas sane ngametuang protes. Wiadining punika, Moffat tetep nyantosang polih ring carane, ngicenangang indik punika cara sane becik ring nglaksanayang pengertian.

Sekolah sane prasida, kadadosang ring Park View Academy, kantosang indik promosi tokoh ekstremis miwah pelaksana aturan agama ketat, ring Chilwell Croft Academy ngicenang kasus nyane nenten presida ngametuang babad ring penyelidikan kale punika.

article_content: To address the escalating threat of deepfakes, India is taking stronger measures. Ashwini Vaishnaw, Minister for Electronics and IT, is leading a high-level meeting on Thursday with top officials and cybersecurity experts to create smart ways to spot and remove deepfake material. This follows a November 18 announcement, where Vaishnaw revealed that key social media firms had been notified to urgently tackle deepfake content on their platforms. Vaishnaw described the challenge as serious and pressed these platforms to take more robust action. He also underlined that if social media companies don’t respond effectively, the Safe Harbour Clause—which typically protects them from liability—may not apply. The meeting’s goal is to establish a thorough approach, enabling both officials and platforms to halt the spread of fake, misleading online content. The move reflects the government’s commitment to fighting misinformation, with hopes that today’s discussions will play a major part in limiting the danger posed by deepfakes on the internet.

Pesamuan puniki matemu kabawosang ring pengumuman 18 November, sane mangdaang incaran utama ring media sosial besar ngametuangang tindakan cepet ngilangang deepfake ring platformne. Vaishnaw nyenengin indik situasi punika pinaka masalah serius lan ngandikayang ring media sosial prasida nglaksanayang langkah sane luwih tegas. Ia taler ngilangangang yening aturan Safe Harbour sane biasane ngawentenang nglindungin hukum ring perusahaan media sosial sampun nenten berlaku yening nenten makta tindakan sane ajeg. article_content: The D.C. City Council has moved forward with plans to decriminalize possession of small amounts of marijuana, giving preliminary approval to new legislation. At present, those caught with marijuana in the city could face up to a year in jail and a $1,000 fine, but the proposed law would allow limited personal possession and significantly lower the penalties. However, some activists believe lawmakers are not acting quickly enough. They’ve submitted language for a ballot initiative to fully legalize possession of up to two ounces of marijuana for adults. If the council’s legislation does not go far enough, the question may be placed directly before D.C. voters in November, where supporters are optimistic that a legalization measure would pass. In the past, Congress blocked D.C.’s efforts to reform marijuana laws, notably preventing the implementation of a 1998 medical marijuana law, which kept many patients from accessing treatment until restrictions were lifted in 2009. Since then, D.C. has gradually developed its marijuana regulation, and Congressional opposition has lessened. Recent Congressional hearings on federal marijuana policy have shown a more pragmatic approach. During one such hearing led by Republican Rep. John Mica, Michael Botticelli from the White House’s drug policy office stated that there are no recorded overdose deaths from marijuana. Today, much of the criticism against marijuana reform comes from former officials rather than current lawmakers. Former Rep. Patrick Kennedy and others have compared the legal cannabis industry to Big Tobacco, but the author argues this is misleading since most businesses in the industry are small and locally owned. The commentary challenges the credibility of critics from privileged backgrounds and points out disparities in drug law enforcement. It concludes that marijuana regulation should be managed by responsible business owners, as voters in places like Colorado and Washington have chosen. This commentary reflects the opinions of Aaron Houston.

article_content: Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt has been accused of hypocrisy for stating that British people do not care sufficiently for the elderly, while recent government cuts have led to nearly 33,000 older people losing access to day care centres. According to data obtained by The Mail on Sunday, since 2010, the number of day care centre places for the elderly has dropped by 37%, from 88,498 in 2010 to 55,655 in 2013. These centres, which provide a vital service to prevent social isolation, have seen the largest reductions in regions like the West Midlands (52% drop) and London (46% drop). Charities such as Friends of the Elderly have described the government's actions as hypocritical, criticizing the launch of campaigns against loneliness amid funding cuts that force the closure of essential services, including community transport and day centres. Richard Furze, Chief Executive of Friends of the Elderly, commented that talking about preventive services without adequate funding is unhelpful, and that the government should not advise others on care while cutting vital support services. Meanwhile, Mr. Hunt, who is married to Lucia, who is Chinese, referenced China as an example of how society treats the elderly more respectfully. However, this view was challenged by Caroline Abrahams, Director at Age UK, who noted that China is industrializing rapidly, with many young people moving to cities for work and leaving older relatives behind. Ten days prior, Mr. Hunt had spoken about 'a forgotten million who live among us – ignored to our national shame,' and suggested families should do more to prevent loneliness. He also remarked on the respect for elderly people in Asian cultures, stating that in China and Japan it is normal for older parents to live with their children. Government proposals to address loneliness have included encouraging elderly people to use tablet computers and video calls to stay connected, a suggestion met with criticism from campaigners. Jane Silk, director of Mature Times newspaper, called this response 'the ultimate insult,' questioning whether virtual contact is an adequate substitute for real companionship. A Department of Health spokesperson responded that while day centres offer valuable services, tackling loneliness requires a change in societal attitudes. The government has allocated an extra £200 million for local authorities in 2014-15 and established a £3.8 billion integrated health and social care budget for 2015-16 to improve the wellbeing of elderly people.

Pusat puniki sampun dados sandaran penting ngupapira tusing maktaang isolasi sosial ring lansia, utamannya ring daerah West Midlands (ngurang 52%) tur London (ngurang 46%). article_content: The Chief of the Air Staff, Air Marshal Hasan Abubakar, has awarded pilot wings to 12 new combat pilots from Basic Flying Course-20 at the 403 Flying Training School in Kano. The announcement was made Thursday by Air Commodore Edward Gabkwet, Director of Public Relations and Information for the Nigerian Air Force (NAF). Air Marshal Abubakar encouraged the graduates to uphold the standards of the Air Force and to contribute their best to ongoing military operations across the country. He emphasized that the NAF’s continued success in independent and joint operations hinges on the addition of capable and energetic pilots. Abubakar highlighted that the Federal Government’s support has enabled the NAF to acquire new aircraft and equipment to bolster efforts against terrorism, insurgency, and other forms of criminality. However, he noted that acquiring new platforms such as the M-346, AH-1Z, A-109 Trekker, and T-129 ATAK helicopters brings increased demands for trained personnel, training, and operational costs. To address existing manpower gaps, Abubakar said the NAF will sustain a three-year pilot training plan starting January 2024, depending on available funding. He expressed satisfaction with the Basic Flying Course 20 graduation, describing it as timely in helping bridge the pilot deficiency gap. The Air Chief reminded the newly winged pilots of the fluid and unpredictable security situation in Nigeria, citing ongoing threats from terrorists in the North, rising banditry and kidnappings nationwide, secessionist groups in the South-East, and continued crude oil theft in the South-South, which threatens Nigeria’s economic well-being. He urged the new pilots to recognize that their journey had only just begun and to continually strive for excellence in order to elevate the NAF’s performance. Earlier, Air Officer Commanding Air Training Command, AVM Nnamdi Ananaba, stated that the graduation marked the final phase of rigorous training aimed at producing fully qualified pilots for the Nigerian Air Force.

Ipun nglaksanayang yenang kasuksesan NAF ring operasi mandiri miwah kerjasama gumantung ring tambah pilot sane sayaga tur semangat. Abubakar ngaturang indik bantu Pemerintah Pusat sane ngametuang NAF prasida medalang pesawat lan peralatan anyar ngelawan terorisme, pemberontakan, miwah kriminalitas lianan. Nanging, nyantosang pesawat anyar M-346, AH-1Z, A-109 Trekker, sareng T-129 ATAK helicopters, punika ngalanturang kabutuhan sumber daya manusia, pelatihan, lan waragad sane nambah. Ngantosangang kekurangan tenaga kerja, Abubakar nglokasinang NAF bakal ngelaksanayang rencana pelatihan pilot ring warsa tiga mulai Januari 2024 gumantung dana sane wenten. Ipun kedas kalaksanayang ring Basic Flying Course 20 punika prasida ngurangin kekurangan pilot. Panglima ngelingang pilot anyar ring kondisi keamanan Nigeria sane ningalin tur nenten ajeg antuk ancaman terorisme ring Wetan Laut, bandit miwah penculikan, kelompok pemisah ring Wetan Kidul, sareng maling minyak ring Selatan, sane ngajegang ekonomi negara. Wenten sareng punika, Panglima Komando Pelatihan Udara, AVM Nnamdi Ananaba, nyarengin kelulusan puniki minangka bagian ring pelatihan ketat sane dadosang pilot becik ring Angkatan Udara Nigeria.

Cathy Watson, 44, and her ex-husband, Robert Hills, 50, have been imprisoned after stealing nearly £500,000 from their daughter Samantha Svendsen's compensation fund. Samantha, now 29, was granted £2.6 million following a birth injury causing cerebral palsy. Instead of preserving it for her care, Watson and Hills spent lavishly on luxury cars, jewellery, cosmetic surgery, and a failed business. 

Watson was sentenced to five and a half years, with Judge Jacqueline Davies condemning her betrayal of a mother’s trust. Hills, who admitted four counts of theft, received three years and four months. Over five years, they used over £117,000 a year on personal luxuries, including multiple high-end vehicles.

Much of the stolen money came through misuse of the Court of Protection's funds intended strictly for Samantha's needs. The couple sold properties purchased for Samantha, keeping the profits, and lost £90,000 on a failed Florida property deal. Now, only £150,000 remains in the fund, with professional care costing around £100,000 annually. Judge Davies said Samantha’s funds will be depleted in about two years, after which the State will have to step in. 

Both Watson and Hills displayed no emotion as they began their prison sentences, while the emotional and financial consequences for Samantha remain.

Samantha, sane sampun rauh ring umur 29 warsa, nenten dados jaga sekadi biasane amargi dados disabilitas kadadosang ring kelahirannyane, miwah medaging cerebral palsy. Dana sane prasida matemu ajengan £2,6 yuta punika kacingakin dados bekal ring kebutuhan hirup Samantha, nanging Watson sareng Hills ngidang nadosangang ajengan punika ring mobil mewah, perhiasan, operasi kecantikan, miwah bisnis sane ajeng gagal.

Watson kasenggol pakrukan limang tawun setengah, dados dadosang pidanayang olih Hakim Jacqueline Davies ring pengkhianatan ring rasa percaya antara ibu sareng anak. Ajengan sane kacanggihin ring lasampun limang warsa puniki ngantos nyantosang £117,000 sataun dados kamewahan sareng ajengan pribadi.

Liu ajengan sane kacanggihin saking Court of Protection sane prasida kagantosangang ring kebutuhan Samantha. Wenten malih properti sane kalaksanayang ring Amerika sane kadadosangang rugi £90,000. article_content: Gisele Bundchen continues to prove she is more than just a supermodel. According to Forbes, she is the highest-earning model of 2014, with estimated earnings of $47 million before taxes and fees over the past year. This marks the eighth consecutive year that Bundchen has led the list of top-earning models. Her impressive income stems from lucrative contracts with major brands such as H&M, Chanel, and Pantene, where she serves as a brand ambassador. Bundchen is also known for being married to football star Tom Brady. Bundchen's earnings far surpass those of the next highest-paid models, Doutzen Kroes and Adriana Lima, who each earned $8 million. Kate Moss, Kate Upton, Miranda Kerr, and Liu Wen all earned $7 million each, with Upton standing out as the highest-earning newcomer on Forbes' list. Forbes also recognized Robert Downey Jr. as Hollywood's highest-paid actor and Sandra Bullock as the highest-paid actress.

Ini sudah tahun kedelapan berturut-turut Gisele Bundchen memuncaki daftar model berpenghasilan tertinggi. Penghasilan luar biasa Gisele ini berasal dari kontrak menguntungkan dengan merek-merek besar seperti H&M, Chanel, serta Pantene, di mana ia menjadi brand ambassador. Gisele Bundchen juga dikenal sebagai istri dari pemain football terkenal, Tom Brady. Penghasilan Bundchen jauh melebihi model-model berpenghasilan tinggi berikutnya, Doutzen Kroes dan Adriana Lima yang masing-masing memperoleh $8 juta. article_content: After far-right outsider Javier Milei was elected as Argentina's president on Sunday, former Fox News host Tucker Carlson celebrated on social media. Carlson shared a photo of himself with Milei, whose campaign he supported by interviewing him on X (formerly Twitter) in September. During the interview, Milei echoed rhetoric similar to that of former US President Donald Trump: he questioned the climate crisis, encouraged right-wing activists to engage in culture wars with liberals, and promised to reduce government spending to tackle Argentina's rising inflation. This interview was part of Carlson's broader effort to promote conservative collaboration internationally, according to A. J. Bauer, assistant professor of journalism at the University of Alabama, speaking to the Reuters Institute. Milei, a libertarian economist and former TV personality, was considered an outsider when he began his campaign to lead South America's second-largest country. His victory was driven by conspiracy theories, bold media appearances, and pledges to confront Argentina's economic crisis with radical actions, including proposing the adoption of the US dollar as the national currency. Milei's campaign drew early comparisons to that of Donald Trump, another outsider whose unique persona helped him win the 2016 US presidential election. Since departing Fox News in 2022, Carlson has built his own media brand on X, interviewing far-right leaders including Hungary's Viktor Orbán, Brazil's Jair Bolsonaro, and El Salvador's Nayib Bukele. While he no longer has the mainstream conservative audience he had at Fox, he remains an influential figure among far-right media; his interview with Milei has been viewed 423 million times as of publication. Bauer told the Reuters Institute, 'He probably knows that he's reaching a more niche audience. Nonetheless, he can still play an important role in shaping the agenda by saying: ‘Hey, you may not know what’s happening in Argentina, but this guy has some interesting ideas that maybe we should consider in the US.’' Carlson maintains close ties with Trump, who is running for president again in 2024 and chose to be interviewed on Carlson's show instead of joining the Republican primary debate in August. As Carlson seeks to bolster far-right movements globally, he likely hopes Milei's win is the first in a wave of conservative victories reminiscent of Trump’s 2016 success. However, critics argue Milei’s drastic proposals may not withstand real-world challenges. He could face a similar outcome as Trump or Bolsonaro and lose power after one term. Benjamin Gedan, director of the Latin America Program at the Wilson Center, told the Associated Press, 'Milei has recently toned down his anti-establishment anger and moderated some of his more extreme proposals, but it's expected to be a turbulent period given his combative style, lack of experience, and few allies in Congress.'

Carlson ngamiletangang photo sareng Milei, sane kampanye nyantosangang uliang wawancara ring X (Twitter sane dados ento) ring wulan September. Ring wawancara puniki, Milei nyantosangang pidarta sane iraga mirib ring mantan Presiden Amerika Serikat, Donald Trump: nyantosangang keraguan ring krisis iklim, ngajak aktivis kanan ngelaksanayang perang budaya sareng liberal, miwah ngajanjian ngedengahin belanja negara nyantosangang ngatasi inflasi Argentina sane numadi. Wawancara puniki dados bagian ring usaha ageng Carlson nyidang ngametuangang kerjasama konservatif ngelanturang jagat, mawiang A. J. Bauer, dosen madya jurnalistik ring Universitas Alabama, ngaturangang ring Reuters Institute. Milei sane dados ekonom libertarian miwah mantan presenter TV, kasuratangang dados outsider rauh ngametuangang kampanye dados pemimpin ring negara ageng ka-dua ring Amerika Selatan puniki. Kemenangannyane kasuratangang olih teori konspirasi, atraksi media sane wani, miwah janji ngelaksanayang solusi radikal ngatasi krisis ekonomi Argentina, kayang ngajengan polih nglaksanayang dolar Amerika dados mata uang nasional. Kampanye Milei sareng langsung kabandingang ring kampanye Donald Trump, outsider sane nganutang ajengan unik ajengan ngidang menang dados Presiden AS ring 2016. Saking medal saking Fox News ring 2022, Carlson prasida ngembangang media brand ring X, ngawawancarai pemimpin kanan ekstrim indik Viktor Orbán saking Hungaria, Jair Bolsonaro saking Brazil, miwah Nayib Bukele saking El Salvador. Wenten audien konservatif utama ring Fox sane prasida sampun kurang, tur ajengan masih mepengaruh ring media kanan ekstrim; wawancara ipun sareng Milei gesang 423 juta kali ring waktu publikasi. Bauer ngaturangang ring Reuters Institute, 'Ipun wentenang nyidang kadadosang ngemetuang audien lebih bansos, makasami masih wenten pengaruh ring agenda sareng ngantosangang, ‘Nah, ida beneh polih sida durung makakasami berita ring Argentina, nanging puniki wenten ide-ide sane patut dados kakaryan ring Amerika Serikat.’' Carlson terus nyantosangang hubungan sareng Trump, sane dados calon presiden dados 2024 tur milih dados wawancara ring acara Carlson nglaksanayang debat utama Republikan ring Agustus. Ring usahang ngemetuangang pengaruh ultrakanan jagat, Carlson prasida nyantosang kemenangan Milei puniki dados awal ring gelombang kemenangan konservatif sekadi menangnyane Trump ring 2016. Namun, para pengritik nylanguang yening solusi radikal Milei prasida maktaang tantangan ring kenyataan. Dados ipun prasida ngidanang nasib sami ring Trump utawi Bolsonaro tur wentenang kasurat ring satu masa bakti. Benjamin Gedan, direktur Program Amerika Latin ring Wilson Center, ngaturangang ring Associated Press, 'Milei rauh maosin amarah anti-establishment miwah ngendahang ide-ide ekstrim ipun, nanging prasida dados masa sane ramai ring wangun gaya ipun sane galak, kurang pengalaman, miwah sekancan wenten sekutu ring Dewan.'

article_content: Kat Cole, now 35, is the president of Cinnabon—a position she achieved after an unlikely journey through the food industry. Cole began working as a waitress at Hooters to pay for her college education, eventually rising to vice president over her 15 years with the company. Coming from modest beginnings, Cole was raised by a single mother who managed to feed her family on just $10 a week, mostly using canned and frozen foods. While working at Hooters' Jacksonville location, Cole was balancing her job and studies at the University of North Florida, where she aspired to become an engineer. As Cole took on more responsibilities at Hooters, including filling in for managers and assisting with new restaurant openings in Australia, Mexico, Argentina, and various U.S. states, her commitment at work began affecting her academic performance. Cole eventually began training employees at Hooters headquarters in Atlanta and, by age 26, had become a vice president without a college degree. She later addressed this by enrolling in Georgia State University's Executive MBA program. In 2010, Cole joined Focus Brands as chief operating officer of Cinnabon, and only two months after earning her MBA, she was promoted to president. Before her work in international markets, Cole had never traveled outside her home state; now, she is a seasoned traveler, recently pictured in Beijing's Olympic Park. Under Cole's leadership, Cinnabon has expanded beyond mall food courts through licensing deals, leading to an expected $1 billion in retail sales this year. Cinnabon's presence now includes partnerships with Taco Bell, Burger King, Keebler, and Green Mountain Coffee, introducing Cinnabon-flavored products across the market. Despite concerns from nutritionists about the Classic Cinnabon Roll's high calorie count (880 calories, 36 grams of fat, and 59 grams of sugar), Cole chose not to alter the product. Market research showed customers prefer the option of indulging in the classic roll occasionally. Cole believes the once-in-a-while treat should remain 'worth it,' reinforcing the brand's identity as an indulgent dessert.

article_content: KALABURAGI: Responding to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's remarks about the tenure of Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah, Congress MLA Priyank Kharge advised that the Prime Minister should familiarize himself with Karnataka's political history. Kharge stated, "The PM should read up on Karnataka's political history. I heard him say that they're unsure how long our Chief Minister will remain in office. He should update his general knowledge regarding Karnataka politics, especially since the BJP had five Chief Ministers in two terms within less than eight years." Speaking in Kalaburagi on Tuesday, Priyank Kharge commented on the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) record in Karnataka. He referred to it as the '40 per cent government,' a term reportedly used by newspapers to describe alleged corruption. Kharge added, "Modi's government was removed from Karnataka, and the people gave Congress the biggest mandate in the last 35-40 years, with 136 seats. The previous government was labeled by newspapers as the most corrupt in the country, calling it the '40 per cent government.' That is the BJP's legacy in Karnataka." Kharge further stated that Congress is open to a political debate, but suggested the Prime Minister should first increase his knowledge of Karnataka. He remarked, "If Modi wants a political discussion, we are ready, but let him update his knowledge on Karnataka's politics and get back to us. The Prime Minister often gives monologues. Once he's ready for a dialogue, we can debate." Regarding Siddaramaiah's tenure as Chief Minister, Kharge said, "Why should the PM be concerned? It is an internal party matter." He acknowledged a previous rivalry for the Chief Minister's post between Siddaramaiah and Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar when Congress came to power in the state. Kharge also referenced the BJP's approach to leadership in other states, noting, "This is the same party that announced Shivraj Singh Chouhan's candidature in the last list. In Maharashtra, they made a former Chief Minister the Deputy Chief Minister while appointing Eknath Shinde as Chief Minister. Does the BJP appear to be in control?" Reflecting on the upcoming state assembly elections, Kharge expressed confidence in Congress's position. "We believe we are on strong footing. The BJP's failed economic policies at the Centre have been exposed, and we expect to return to power in all five states," he said. Earlier on Sunday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi raised questions during a rally in Madhya Pradesh about the continuation of Karnataka's Chief Minister.

Kharge nyarengin, "PM maseosang prasida maca sejarah politik Karnataka. Tiang rumasa mireng mantuk beliau ngidangang yening ten pasti indik masa jabatan gubernur makta. Dados sampun prasida tambahang pengetahuan ring politik Karnataka, tur BJP sampun nglaksanayang lima gubernur ring dua periode ringangang punika ring langkung ring ajeng sangang warsa." Ngantos ring Kalaburagi ring Rahina Anggara, Priyank Kharge ngidangang komentar ring catetan Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) ring Karnataka. Pemerintahan sane kamula kasurat koran dados pemerintah paling korup, nenten sekadi punika 'pemerintah 40 persen'. Puniki warisan BJP ring Karnataka." Perdana Menteri biasane seneng pidato monolog. Uma prasida siap ring dialog, prasida bae debat." Indik masa jabatan Siddaramaiah pinaka Gubernur, Kharge matemuangang, "Ngidangang punika dadi urusan partai sor ring Kongres." Ipun ngametuangang indik persaingan ring jabatan Gubernur antuk Siddaramaiah sareng Wakil Gubernur DK Shivakumar waktu Kongres ngidangangang kekuasaan ring Karnataka. Ring pemilihan umum legislatif ring limang negara sane dadosang, Kharge ngidangang yening Kongres percaya sampun kuat. "Kami yakin kanti posisi kuat. Kebijakan ekonomi BJP ring Pusat sampun kabukti ten berhasil, sareng prasida balik nyangkemang kekuasaan ring limang negara puniki," pesan ipun. Pidato ring Rahina Redite, Perdana Menteri Narendra Modi prasida ngidangang indik kepastian masa jabatan Gubernur Karnataka ring rally ring Madhya Pradesh.

article_content: Each year, The Game Awards faces the same issue: the overlap between Game of the Year (GOTY) contenders and winners of genre-specific categories. Kotaku’s Ethan Gach has proposed a solution—if a game is nominated for GOTY, it should not be eligible for genre awards. This is unlike the Oscars, which do not have separate categories for genres like Best Horror Movie or Best Action Blockbuster. At The Game Awards, many genre awards feature the same titles nominated for GOTY, making outcome predictions more obvious. If a GOTY nominee is also competing in a genre, it will likely win that category, or its absence makes little sense. Similarly, if multiple GOTY nominees appear in a single genre, whoever wins in that category is unlikely to win GOTY, reducing suspense. This scenario is particularly evident this year. For example, in the Best RPG category: Final Fantasy XVI, Starfield, and Baldur’s Gate 3 are all contenders. Baldur’s Gate 3, being a GOTY nominee, is widely expected to win over the others. The same issue arises in the Best Action Adventure category, which includes four out of six GOTY nominees. If Alan Wake 2 wins Best Action Adventure, it narrows the actual GOTY competition to just a few titles. Gach argues that excluding GOTY nominees from genre categories would make for a more exciting, less predictable awards show and would allow more games to gain recognition—especially in strong years. The downside is that winners in genre categories might feel their victory is diminished if a major contender like Baldur’s Gate 3 is absent. Another extreme solution would be to eliminate genre awards altogether, which would reduce the number of games honored. Overall, Gach feels his proposed solution solves more problems than it creates, as it would restore mystery around the outcomes and spotlight additional titles. However, so far, The Game Awards creator Geoff Keighley has not implemented these changes.
translated_content: Sasampun warsa puniki, The Game Awards polih ngalanturang indik sane taler warsa warsa. Indik nyane, overlap antara nominasi Game of the Year (GOTY) lan pemenang ring kategori genre. Ethan Gach saking Kotaku ngusulin solusi—yening dados nominasi ring GOTY, tusing prasida ikut ring nominasi genre tiosan. Puniki beda sareng Oscars sane tusing makta kategori-kategori genre cara Best Horror Movie utawi Best Action Blockbuster. Ring The Game Awards, akeh kategori genre malih kapertamayang judul sane nenten dados nominasi GOTY, sane ngelaksanayang ajengan pemenang prasida kasuratang. Yening nominasi GOTY dados ring genre, biasane ia prasida menang. Yening tusing, iraga ajengan mautsaha nenten masuk akal. Yening dados akeh nominasi GOTY ring satu kategori genre, pemenang ring punika biasane nenten prasida menang GOTY. Sapunika ajengan dados langkung kebacang. Indik punika prasida makta ring warsa puniki. Contone ring kategori Best RPG: Final Fantasy XVI, Starfield, miwah Baldur's Gate 3 taler masuk. Baldur’s Gate 3, sebagai nominasi GOTY, sampun kapidabdabin pinaka pemenang. Punapisan ring kategori Best Action Adventure, sane ngidangang pat patang saking enam nominasi GOTY. Yening Alan Wake 2 menang Best Action Adventure, kompetisi GOTY dados masi ring sawatara judul bin. Gach nyarengin, yening nominasi GOTY tusing dados ring kategori genre, ajengan dados langkung menarik lan nenten mudah ditebak, dadosang Game Awards dados langkung rame. Malih, langkung akeh permainan prasida dados perhatian—mawinan warsa sane kuat. Nanging, pemenang kategori genre dados ngalanturang kemenangang prasida ngrasa kurang utawi genah yening pesaing utama kayang Baldur's Gate 3 tusing melajah. Solusi tiosan, ngilangangang kategori genre ento, nanging ajengan dados langkung sedikit. Ring intinya, Gach percaya solusi puniki nglaksanayang solusi sane becik indik masalah indik The Game Awards—ngelaksanayang hasil luwih misterius lan ngemargiang lebih permainan. Nanging, Geoff Keighley sane ngemargiang The Game Awards, durung nganut solusi puniki.

article_content: UPSC Essentials presents a focused initiative for Mains answer writing practice, addressing key static and dynamic topics from the Civil Services syllabus included in various GS papers. This exercise aims to strengthen preparation for the UPSC CSE Mains. Attempt today's answer writing on GS-1 topics to assess your understanding. Gwalior has been inducted into the UNESCO Creative Cities Network (UCCN) in recognition of its strong dedication to fostering culture and creativity. This article also examines the contributions of the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) in preserving Indian art and architecture. Introduction: Craft your introduction carefully, keeping it within 3-5 lines and including definitions or statistics from credible sources. Body: Address the question's requirements with structured content—use a mix of bullet points and concise paragraphs. Incorporate validated facts from government or authoritative sources. Provide analysis relevant to the question. Use flowcharts or diagrams where they add value. Emphasize important keywords for clarity. Conclusion: Conclude with a positive, forward-looking perspective. You may highlight any major concerns if needed but avoid repetition. Drawing on findings from reports or official surveys, or including relevant quotations, can enhance the conclusion. Self-Evaluation: Continual self-assessment is crucial. UPSC Essentials offers points for effective self-evaluation. Question 1: Gwalior's inclusion in the UNESCO Creative Cities Network highlights its longstanding commitment to cultural vibrancy and creativity. Alongside Kozhikode, Kerala, Gwalior is celebrated for its rich musical tradition. The city's cultural legacy is shaped by the Gwalior gharana—the oldest gharana in Hindustani classical music—cultivated under Raja Man Singh Tomar in the 15th century. Dungarendra Singh Tomar backed the revival of Indian classical music, contributing two key Sanskrit music treatises to Sultan Zain-ul-Abdin. The Gwalior gharana became a foundational school of classical music, evolving further during Mughal times. Forms such as Khayal and bandish ki thumri developed here, and artists like Mian Tansen received their early musical grounding in Gwalior before serving under Emperor Akbar. Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan is another prominent figure in Gwalior's musical lineage. These legacies underpin Gwalior's status as a leading center for music. Question 2: The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), functioning under the Ministry of Culture, is India's prime organization for archaeological research and cultural heritage protection. It operates under the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958, and the Antiquities and Art Treasures Act, 1972. Established in 1861 with Alexander Cunningham as its first director-general, the ASI spearheaded systematic research and preservation of India's historical sites. Cunningham's efforts identified major sites including Harappa, Bairat, Kosambi, Nalanda, Taxila, and Vaishali. Although the ASI faced early challenges, it was reestablished and guided by directors like John Marshall, under whom notable excavations took place at Sanchi, Pataliputra, Sravasthi, Bhita, and Charsada, adding significantly to India's archaeological record. Today, the ASI manages 37 Circles nationwide, overseeing the conservation of ancient monuments through museums, excavation teams, epigraphy, science, horticulture, building and temple survey operations, and underwater archaeology. Its professionals continue safeguarding India’s ancient heritage. article_content: Netflix continues to bolster its action lineup each month, delivering new films to entertain audiences at home. From historical epics like Gladiator and Saving Private Ryan to adrenaline-pumping thrillers like The Fast and the Furious and Luther: The Fallen Sun, Netflix offers a diverse range of films for every action fan. Here are three handpicked action movies you should add to your Netflix queue and watch this October. Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol is the fourth entry in the Mission: Impossible series, and it shifted the franchise's focus towards larger stunts and spectacular action sequences. In this film, Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his IMF team are blamed for a bombing at the Kremlin. As a result, the U.S. president activates 'Ghost Protocol,' disavowing the IMF and forcing Ethan and his team to go rogue to clear the agency's name and stop further attacks. One of the film's memorable moments includes Tom Cruise scaling the Burj Khalifa in Dubai. Mission: Impossible – Ghost Protocol is now streaming on Netflix. Gina Prince-Bythewood's The Woman King follows an elite group of female warriors defending the West African kingdom of Dahomey in 1823. The Agojie, an all-female army led by General Nanisca (Viola Davis), trains young recruits like Nawi (Thuso Mbedu). When Portuguese slave traders join forces with the Agojie's enemies, the Oyo, the women face a brutal showdown. The Woman King is a powerful historical epic, evoking the kind of film Hollywood rarely produces today. Stream The Woman King on Netflix. Christopher Nolan’s Dark Knight trilogy began in 2005 with Batman Begins, which explores Bruce Wayne’s journey from tragedy to becoming Gotham’s protector. After his parents' murder, young Bruce is raised by his butler Alfred Pennyworth (Michael Caine). Years later, Bruce (Christian Bale) leaves Gotham, seeking justice abroad. Under the training of Henri Ducard (Liam Neeson) and the League of Shadows, Bruce learns to fight but ultimately rejects their vision for Gotham. Instead, he returns to save the city as Batman. Batman Begins is streaming on Netflix.

article_content: Steven Moffat, the lead writer and executive producer of "Doctor Who," has affirmed there’s no obstacle to casting a woman as the Doctor. Moffat noted that he has already laid the groundwork within the series to make the transition possible, incorporating hints and story elements in earlier seasons. Discussing his approach to casting, Moffat underlined the importance of selecting whoever is most suited for the part, regardless of gender. "It’s about choosing the person who embodies the Doctor best at the time," he said. Moffat also shared that Peter Capaldi was the clear favorite for the current incarnation, with widespread agreement among those involved. This view contrasts with Peter Davison, who played the fifth Doctor and has voiced his disagreement with the concept of a female Doctor. Betting agencies are giving 8/1 odds for a woman to take on the Doctor’s role in the future. Tilda Swinton, Billie Piper, Olivia Colman, and Helen Mirren are among the notable actresses speculated for the part. The series recently marked its 50th anniversary with a special episode, "The Day of the Doctor." The event showcased Matt Smith, David Tennant, and John Hurt as different versions of the Doctor and included a fleeting introduction of Peter Capaldi as the next lead. Capaldi, familiar to audiences from "The Thick Of It," has yet to fully step into the role, but his brief appearance during the anniversary was a highlight alongside the return of famous adversaries like the Daleks. Tom Baker, known for his long tenure as the Doctor, appeared at the close of the special. The anniversary was further commemorated with a convention in London, hosting former Doctors and fans. While the special was praised for its high production values and witty script, some viewers found the story intricate and difficult to follow. A sense of nostalgia and humor pervades, echoing the enduring appeal and transformation of the series and its fandom over time.

Manipur police have filed a First Information Report (FIR) against Muan Tombing, general secretary of the Indigenous Tribal Leader's Forum (ITLF), following alleged comments advocating a separate administration. In response, the ITLF strongly condemned the FIR and defended its long-standing demand for a separate administration for Kuki-Zo tribals, emphasizing that they seek a solution within the framework of the Indian constitution.

ITLF Media & Publicity lead Ginza Vualzong stated that accusations of sedition and conspiracy to wage war against the Indian government are unfounded. He also noted that previous police cases against ITLF's chairman and spokesperson were part of attempts to suppress the tribal movement.

Vualzong described the rationale behind the demand for a separate administration, citing violence against Kuki-Zo civilians in Meitei-dominated areas—including the state capital—where many were killed or displaced. He claimed survivors cannot return home and alleged that Meitei civil society groups have declared 'war' on the Kuki-Zo. He accused the state government and police of siding with the Meitei community, with commandos allegedly leading attacks on tribal villages. He further claimed that development funds intended for tribal welfare are being diverted to Meitei NGOs, citing an instance where the Chief Minister requested the Tribal Affairs Minister approve multiple projects for NGOs based in Imphal that, according to ITLF, do not serve tribal interests.

Vualzong also alleged attempts to erase tribal history, such as the education minister's reported promise to remove a chapter on the Kuki community from textbooks. He said tribal government employees and MLAs are unable to reach Imphal and cannot serve their constituents, and that essential central aid must be routed through Mizoram because Meitei mobs prevent it from reaching tribal areas. According to ITLF, tribes have lost access to both rail and air transport links.

Citing ongoing delays in the central government's response, ITLF called for an interim separate secretariat to allow their administration to function.

The FIR against Muan Tombing alleges conspiracy to wage war, sedition, provocation with intent to cause riot, and abetting criminal conspiracy, under multiple sections of the IPC. The complaint was lodged by Inspector N Thangzamuan of Churachandpur Police Station.

Ruling legislators in Manipur jointly condemned the ITLF's statements, calling them legally and constitutionally baseless, and stated that appropriate legal action is underway. A government statement labelled ITLF’s remarks as irresponsible and capable of disturbing the law-and-order situation.

On Wednesday, the ITLF organized a mass protest rally in Churachandpur to reiterate its core demand for a separate administration. Following the recent violence, 10 Kuki legislators—including MLAs from the BJP, Kuki People's Alliance, and an Independent—have also demanded a separate administration in Manipur. Several Kuki organizations continue to press for autonomy.

Ethnic tensions in Manipur escalated dramatically on May 3, after a tribal solidarity rally in Churachandpur turned violent, sparking widespread clashes between Chin-Kuki-Zo and Meitei communities. According to Manipur police, the ongoing conflict has left 175 dead, 1,108 injured, and 32 people missing.

Polisi Manipur sampun ngajang laporan polisi (FIR) ring Muan Tombing, Sekretaris Jenderal Indigenous Tribal Leader's Forum (ITLF), indik dugaan pernyataan sane nyarengin tuntutan administrasi pisah. ITLF nglaksanayang kecibakang ring FIR puniki lan nyidayang tuntutan administrasi pisah ring Kuki-Zo, ngicenang yening tuntutan punike kasuratang ring Undang-Undang Dasar India.

Ginza Vualzong, panglimbak media ITLF, nyariangang yening tuduhan makar miwah konspirasi ngalaksanayang perang nglawan pamarintah India punika tan wenten dasarnya. Ia nyarengin, laporan polisi nglawan Ketua ITLF lan juru bicara punika minangka usaha nyagilin gerakan tribal.

Vualzong ngeranjingang alasan tuntutan adminstrasi pisah, maktaang kekerasan ring warga Kuki-Zo ring wilayah sane kadominasi olih Meitei, kalebet ring ibu kota. Idane maktaang akeh korban miwah sane hidup taler ten prasida mulih. Ia nglaksanayang tuduhan paguyuban sipil Meitei nglubakang perangan nglawan Kuki-Zo, sareng pamarintah negara sareng kepolisian majeng ring pihak Meitei, napikin komando ngalaksanayang serangan ring desa tribal. Ia maktaang dana pengembangan sane harusne kaanggo masyarakat tribal malih kasadyaang ring NGO Meitei, ngicenang yening perbekel nyarengin Menteri Urusan Tribal ngaproval proyek ring NGO ring Imphal sane tak ngaang manfaat ring tribal.

Ia nyarengin yening wenten upaya ngilangangang sejarah tribal, wantah indik Menteri Pendidikan ngucapang ngilangangang bab 'Kuki' ring buku sekolah. Pegawai pamarintah tribal miwah anggota dewan ten prasida ngampura ring Imphal miwah nganggen kewajiban ipun. Malih, bantuan pemerintah pusat teken ngalanturang ring Mizoram, beling Meitei ngcegah bantuan ring kawasan tribal. ITLF nyarengin akses ring jalan utama lan bandara kapungkur kapotong.

Yening pemerintah pusat masih nglaksanayang nenten jelas, ITLF ngidangang sekretariat sementara ngicenang pegawai pemerintah lan anggota dewan prasida nglaksanayang tugas ring masyarakat.

FIR nglawan Muan Tombing nganggen pasal konspirasi ngalaksanayang perang, makar, provokasi nglaksanayang kerusuhan, miwah ngajak konspirasi pidana ring makudang pasal IPC. Laporan puniki kasuratang olih Inspektur N Thangzamuan saking Polsek Churachandpur.

Anggota dewan penguasa Manipur ngcibakang pernyataan ITLF, maktaang nenten wenten dasar hukum miwah konstitusi, miwah nglaksanayang tindakan hukum. Pemerintah ngucapang pernyataan ITLF kadadosang irresponsibel lan prasida ngganggu ketertiban.

Ring budal Rabu, ITLF ngametuangang aksi unjuk rasa ageng ring Churachandpur nguatang tuntutan administrasi pisah. Saksampun kekerasan ring negara, 10 anggota dewan Kuki – kalebet saking BJP, Kuki People's Alliance, lan satu independen – ngametuangang tuntutan administrasi pisah. Organisasi Kuki sareng presida nyaring tuntutan otonomi.

Ketegangan etnis ring Manipur dados ngregeb ring 3 Mei, indik unjuk rasa solidaritas tribal ring Churachandpur sane dados ricuh, nglulungang benturan antar Chin-Kuki-Zo lan Meitei. Polisi Manipur nglingayang konflik puniki ngemantenang 175 mati, 1.108 luka-luka, lan 32 orang diduga ilang.

article_content: An independent inquiry has been launched into a hospital after allegations of serious mistakes in the treatment of a child who died. Luke Jenkins, a seven-year-old from Cardiff, died following what was expected to be straightforward heart surgery at Bristol Children’s Hospital in April 2012. Although doctors anticipated a full recovery, Luke suffered a fatal cardiac arrest. His family contends that more could have been done to save him. A coroner provided a narrative conclusion about his death in November 2013, but this did not satisfy Luke’s family. Alongside similar cases, this dissatisfaction has prompted the recent launch of an independent investigation—the Bristol Review—into the hospital’s children’s cardiac unit. The review aims to collect testimony from families who believe their children were adversely affected by medical staff. The hospital faces accusations of neglect and insufficient care for babies and children with heart conditions. Reportedly, about ten families—some of whose children died after care at the hospital—are now pursuing legal action against the NHS trust. Faye Valentine, Luke's mother, has campaigned for better healthcare, stating she believes her son’s death was preventable. She is motivated by the hope of justice and a safer environment for future patients, urging the hospital to recognize its mistakes and take steps to improve. Eleanor Grey QC, who is leading the inquiry on behalf of NHS England, has stressed that confidentiality and support for witnesses are priorities. There will be no public hearings; witnesses can present their evidence privately and may bring a supporter or union representative. The inquiry will also provide free professional emotional support. The review covers cardiac care provided to pediatric patients, as well as family experiences, from March 2010 to the present, though incidents before that date will be considered if relevant. Input from all witnesses—regardless of whether it is positive or negative—will be useful. Professor Sir Ian Kennedy QC, previously chair of a major inquiry into children’s heart surgery at the hospital in 2001, is serving as an advisor. Eleanor Grey also has previous experience as counsel in that earlier investigation. University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, which operates the hospital, has welcomed the review and affirmed its commitment to cooperating fully. The trust emphasized the importance of enabling families to easily share their experiences, and stated that Eleanor Grey QC and her team would have unrestricted access to information and support from staff throughout the process.

article_content: Sky Sports News turned transfer deadline day into a true entertainment event this season, unveiling a redesigned studio and delivering energetic, theatrical coverage. Jim White, known for his enthusiastic countdowns, led the team alongside presenters like Kate Abdo and Natalie Sawyer, keeping fans updated with the latest developments. From early morning, the studio buzzed with excitement, mirroring the pace of significant sporting occasions. Multiple live feeds, up-to-the-minute updates from reporters across the country, and lively interactions set a vibrant, sometimes chaotic tone for the broadcast. Reporters in the field encountered surprises: Gary Cotterill struggled to control enthusiastic crowds with a referee’s vanishing spray, while Alan Irwin was playfully interrupted by a prank on air. Audience involvement was high, often causing disruptions or awkward moments, prompting presenters such as Natalie Sawyer to make live apologies for any unexpected behavior. Despite the entertainment value, Sky Sports News maintained strong journalism, delivering the latest transfer deals, detailed analysis, and continuous coverage. Still, some argue that the ongoing quest for spectacle risks burying substantive reporting, prompting questions about whether the channel’s showmanship is obscuring its journalistic roots. With this year's transfer window lacking blockbuster moves, the coverage itself became the highlight. As Sky Sports News leans more into drama and entertainment, there’s growing debate about the need to balance engaging TV with serious journalism in football reporting.

article_content: Former President Donald Trump's 2024 campaign is urging the Republican National Committee (RNC) to cancel all remaining scheduled presidential primary debates after he chose to skip this cycle's first two debates. Senior advisors Susie Wiles and Chris LaCivita released a joint statement on Monday, calling on the RNC to "immediately cancel the upcoming debate in Miami and end all future debates to refocus its manpower and money on preventing Democrats' efforts to steal the 2024 election." They added, "Anything less, along with other reasons not to cancel, are an admission to the grassroots that their concerns about voter integrity are not taken seriously and that national Republicans care more about helping Joe Biden than ensuring a safe and secure election." The RNC has not responded to Insider's request for comment. The Trump campaign's push to end the GOP's primary debates comes a week after Trump skipped the second Republican debate in California, which saw candidates repeatedly talking over each other. Previously, Trump also skipped the first primary debate in late August, opting instead for a pre-taped interview with former TV host Tucker Carlson, which aired minutes before the debate began. During his 2015 presidential campaign, Trump appeared in multiple primary debates but opted out of one in Iowa in January 2016, which he later described as having "turned out great." In 2020, he withdrew from the second presidential debate after the Commission on Presidential Debates shifted the format to virtual due to his recent COVID-19 diagnosis. Despite his history of skipping debates, Trump remains the clear frontrunner in the GOP presidential race. According to a national polling average from FiveThirtyEight, he leads by 41.7 percentage points over his closest rival, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis.

article_content: Veteran character actress Elizabeth Hoffman, best known for her role as Beatrice Reed Ventnor—the mother of the titular sisters played by Swoosie Kurtz, Sela Ward, Patricia Kalember, and Julianne Phillips—on NBC’s 1990s drama series 'Sisters', has died at the age of 97. Hoffman passed away of natural causes on August 21 at her home in Malibu, California, her son Chris confirmed to The Hollywood Reporter. Born in Corvallis, Oregon, Hoffman made her television debut in 1980, recurring as Miss Mason on 'Little House on the Prairie'. She made her feature film debut in 1981 as the lead in Frank LaLoggia’s supernatural horror film 'Fear No Evil'. Hoffman is also remembered for portraying Eleanor Roosevelt in 'The Winds of War', a television miniseries directed and produced by Dan Curtis, which covered the early years of World War II. She reprised the role of Eleanor Roosevelt in the 1988 miniseries 'War and Remembrance'. Hoffman appeared in Monte Hellman’s 1989 horror film 'Silent Night, Deadly Night 3: Better Watch Out!' Two years later, she secured the role of Beatrice on 'Sisters', which she played throughout all six seasons from 1991 to 1996. Her additional credits include playing Dr. Johnson opposite Barbra Streisand in the 1987 film 'Nuts'. She also guest-starred on television series such as 'Matlock' and 'thirtysomething', and appeared in several movies, including playing Grandma Ruth in 'Dante’s Peak'. Her most recent television appearance was as Dr. Catherine Langford in 'Stargate SG-1' from 1997 to 1998.

article_content: FRANKFURT, Germany — The European Union's executive commission has revised down its economic growth forecasts for this year and next, citing lost momentum driven by persistent inflation and higher interest rates that are discouraging spending and investment. In its autumn economic forecast released Wednesday, the commission now expects 0.6% growth this year for the 20 eurozone countries, down from the previous estimate of 0.8%. Forecasted growth for next year was also trimmed to 1.2% from 1.3%. The review points to risks stemming from Russia's ongoing war against Ukraine and the conflict between Israel and Hamas in Gaza. So far, the Gaza conflict has not disrupted oil supplies from major Middle Eastern producers such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, and oil prices have recently declined. Additionally, Europe's underground natural gas storage facilities are full ahead of the winter season. Despite this, 'the main risk that we see is energy prices,' said Paolo Gentiloni, the EU's Commissioner for Economy. Gentiloni warned that a broader regional conflict could push energy prices higher if it spreads to include neighboring countries. While economic growth remains weak, unemployment is still near record lows, and the commission expects improvement as inflation subsides, giving consumers greater spending power. At the same time, government deficits and debt have declined following substantial stimulus spending during the COVID-19 pandemic. Gentiloni noted that hopes for recovery rest on investment and spending from the EU’s pandemic recovery fund, as well as continued strength in the labor market. 'Importantly, this forecast foresees wage growth exceeding inflation, finally allowing workers to at least partially recover purchasing power,' he said. The eurozone economy has seen minimal growth this year: zero increase in the first quarter, a slight 0.2% uptick in the third quarter, and a 0.1% contraction. Inflation dropped to 2.9% in October, down from a peak of 10.6% a year earlier, after the European Central Bank raised its key interest rate from -0.5% to 4% in just over a year. Higher interest rates are central banks’ main tool for controlling inflation, but they can also weigh on growth by making borrowing more expensive for both consumers and businesses.

article_content: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has filed a chargesheet against fugitive defence dealer Sanjay Bhandari, naming two additional accused: NRI businessman CC Thampi, who was arrested in 2020 in a money laundering case, and S Chadha. This is the second chargesheet against Bhandari, who continues to fight India's attempts at his extradition from the UK where he currently resides. Bhandari is wanted in India for allegedly receiving payments related to several defence deals through shell companies registered in the UAE. Thampi, based in Dubai, was arrested by the ED in January 2020 as part of a money laundering investigation involving Robert Vadra, the son-in-law of former Congress president Sonia Gandhi. He was accused of non-cooperation with authorities and of acquiring undisclosed properties in Dubai, London, and other countries. During questioning, Thampi claimed that it was Sonia Gandhi’s personal assistant, PP Madhavan, who introduced him to Vadra. Investigators suspect that Thampi acted as a front for politicians, managing entities in Dubai such as Skylight Hospitality FZE and Skylight Investment FZE, both of which later purchased properties in London and a villa in Dubai. After authorities began probing Vadra's links with Thampi, Thampi transferred his entire ownership in Skylight Investment FZE (comprising one share of 150,000 dirhams) to his step-sister's son, Vadakkethala Cheru Geever. Geever, through a shell company, now owns both a London flat at 12 Ellorton House, Bryanston Square, valued at Rs 26 crore, and a villa in Dubai worth over Rs 14 crore.

article_content: Five-year-old Ashya King is set to undergo proton beam therapy in Prague starting tomorrow. After his time in Spain, he was transported to Prague by private jet for treatment at the city’s Proton Therapy Center. Both of his parents, Brett and Naghemeh King, are with him at Motol University Hospital as preparations are made for his radiotherapy. Family friend Daniel Pask confirmed that the treatment is moving forward and mentioned the parents’ relief in securing the care they wanted for Ashya. The family arrived in Prague last week following their release from custody in Spain, where they were briefly detained due to removing Ashya from a UK hospital without doctors’ consent. The conflict arose when medical staff at Southampton General Hospital declined proton therapy, citing the extent of Ashya's cancer. Proton beam therapy enables targeted treatment of tumors with reduced impact on healthy tissue. Ashya’s family is optimistic that the Prague treatment will give him the best possible chance.
