Research reveals that many UK rail fares have more than tripled since privatisation two decades ago. Some open return tickets now cost more than family flights to popular Mediterranean destinations or even a solo trip to New York. Barry Doe, a leading rail fare analyst, found that fares on high-demand routes have risen between 141% and 246% since 1995, while general inflation increased by 77% over the same period. For example, a Virgin Trains open return ticket from London to Manchester rose from £96 in 1995 to £329 in 2015—a 243% increase. 

The study compares train fares to alternatives: the Manchester open return is over eight times pricier than a National Express coach fare (£39.50), and can buy a family of four a flight to Barcelona (£184) or Athens (£240). A solo flight to New York with Kuwait Airways costs £334, only slightly more than the Manchester train fare.

These findings follow a watchdog report indicating passenger satisfaction with UK railways is at a five-year low, with frequent complaints about overcrowding, high fares, and delays. In January, rail fares rose by an average of 2.2%; season tickets increased by 2.5%, both outpacing inflation and most wage growth. Complaints have grown over large bonuses for rail executives, labelled as ‘rewards for failure’.

Barry Doe’s research, commissioned by the Transport Salaried Staffs Association (TSSA) union, showed open return fares from London have surged: to Bristol, up from £57 to £197 (246%); to Liverpool, from £93 to £309 (232%); and to Cardiff, £70 to £218 (211%).

With these rising fares, driving is becoming more attractive. Edmund King, president of the AA, remarked that his £4,028 annual rail season ticket could purchase a used car, pay for insurance, taxes, and cover fuel for two years’ average driving.

Virgin Trains defended the £329 London-Manchester fare, noting only 3.7% of passengers pay it, with most choosing cheaper options. The company points out that many advanced fares from Manchester have remained stable or dropped, with their overall fare increase at 1.4%, below the industry average. Network Rail and train operators, through the Rail Delivery Group, argue that TSSA figures are misleading as they only highlight the most expensive fares, emphasizing that average rail fares have increased by 6% in real terms over the last 15 years. Passenger numbers have nearly doubled, aiding higher investment in the network.

Labour’s transport spokesman Michael Dugher and TSSA general secretary Manuel Cortes are strongly critical of the current fare regime, highlighting high prices, executive pay, and declining satisfaction as evidence of privatisation’s failures.

At the Rolling Stones’ Adelaide Oval concert, Erin John Vallance, part of the backstage crew, rushed onto the stage in hopes of meeting the band. Security swiftly tackled and removed the 31-year-old, leading to his eviction and the loss of his glasses.

Vallance received a $560 fine for disorderly conduct, which is much lower than penalties typically given to AFL pitch invaders. Frontman Mick Jagger made light of the moment, telling the crowd it was just 'Aussie rules tackling.' Meanwhile, guitarist Keith Richards moved Vallance’s glasses off stage for safety.

Following the incident, Vallance posted online that the security response resulted in blood clots but said the experience was still worth it. He apologized for disrupting the show and requested his glasses be returned.

Adelaide Oval Management clarified that Vallance, a crew member, was not a regular attendee and was handed to South Australia Police. His future job prospects in the industry may now be affected.

article_content: Complaints about unfair and excessive penalty notices from private parking firms have surged, with Citizens Advice reporting a 41% increase in grievances over the past year. In addition, visits to the organization's website for parking-related help have tripled to 155,000. These private parking companies operate in a range of locations from hospitals and railway stations to supermarkets, and often access motorists' sensitive personal data through the DVLA, which generated nearly £25 million over five years by selling this information. Many criticize the DVLA for issuing this data without ensuring the companies comply with regulations. Private parking firms made 2.5 million requests for driver details from the DVLA in the year ending March 2014, rising by a third from 1.9 million the previous year. Firms use number plate recognition cameras, similar to those used by police, to issue penalty notices. A campaign by the Daily Mail revealed several instances of aggressive enforcement, particularly at hospital car parks, including vulnerable groups such as cancer patients. In response, the Local Government Secretary Eric Pickles launched an investigation, and Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt introduced new guidelines for hospitals to curtail excessive fines for minor infringements. Complaints documented by Citizens Advice included cases like a pregnant mother fined £140 for urgent hospital parking, a Cambridgeshire woman mistakenly fined for a six-hour stay due to faulty cameras, and a man in Greater Manchester penalized due to a ticketing machine malfunction. Civil law requires penalties for parking on private land to reflect the owner's actual losses, yet many charges are around £100 (reduced to £50 for prompt payment), and some have reached £300. An analysis found that one in six complainants had paid for parking but still received a penalty. Other common issues include insufficient signage, faulty ticket machines, and technical errors with number plate recognition. Earlier reports highlighted some firms, such as MET Parking, employing debt collection or legal practices that had faced regulatory action. Many motorists struggle to contact companies to resolve charges, often worsening due to higher penalties if not paid promptly. CA advises motorists to consider appealing if, for example, they followed parking rules, bought and displayed a ticket, faced machine faults, or experienced compassionate circumstances (such as illness or emergencies). Charges can also be disputed if the amount is incorrect, already paid, or if discrimination occurred. From October 2013 to September 2014, Citizens Advice provided online help to over 155,000 people regarding private land parking issues, up from about 69,000 the previous year. Its offices assisted with 914 such cases between July and September 2014, an increase from 646 the previous year. CA is calling on the British Parking Association and the Independent Parking Commission to establish clear and standardized 'grace periods' for drivers, as current guidance is vague. CA’s chief executive Gillian Guy urged for parking enforcement to reflect genuine losses and for companies to improve communication and transparency. The British Parking Association did not comment on the recent increase in complaints but previously stated its commitment to fair and responsible enforcement and noted the existence of an appeals process for disputing penalty notices.

Perusahaan parkir swasta puniki ngoperasikang ring rumah sakit, stasiun kereta, miwah supermarket, nyansan aksés ring data pribadi pengendara lewat DVLA sane ngasilang penghasilan sekancan £25 juta ring limang warsa ngametuangang data puniki. Ring Oktober 2013 ngantos September 2014, Citizens Advice nglaksanayang pitulung online ring 155.000 kasus parkir tanah swasta, ngalantur saking 69.000 ring warsa makurenan. Kantor ngajinayang 914 kasus ring Juli–September 2014, nincapang saking 646 warsa makurenan. CA nyarengin British Parking Association sareng Independent Parking Commission ngajengin aturan 'grace period' sane jelas miwah baku. Kepala eksekutif CA Gillian Guy ngicanayang aturan parkir kedah nganut kerugian nyata miwah perusahaan ngametuang komunikasi lan transparansi sane becik. British Parking Association prasida nenten ngicenang komentar indik peningkatan keluhan, sareng ngajinayang komitmen penegakan sane adil tur wenten sistem banding ring denda.

article_content: France is advancing with plans to build a significant offshore wind farm near the Normandy beaches, where the D-Day landings of World War II took place. The project proposes 75 turbines, each 100 meters tall, set to be located about eight miles out at sea and visible from the Juno and Omaha beach memorials. The initiative is headed by the French electricity company EDF, with the turbines distributed across five offshore sites along Normandy’s coast, covering a total area of 330 square miles and with an estimated cost near ten million pounds. One location is off Courseulles-sur-Mer, close to Juno Beach, notable for the Canadian and British troops who landed there on June 6, 1944. EDF aims to have the wind farms operational by 2015, with the capacity to generate six gigawatts of electricity per year, equating to about 3.5% of France’s electricity needs. This project is part of France’s broader goal to have renewable sources supply almost a quarter of its energy by 2030. The proposal has sparked mixed reactions. Some campaigners and residents argue that the turbines could diminish the site’s historical significance. Claude Brevan and Jean-Louis Butre are among those expressing strong opposition, saying the installations would not honor the sacrifices made during the landings. Others, like former local councillor Anne d'Ornano, report that many veterans and locals accept the development of renewable energy when the area’s history is respected. Canadian veterans consulted have reportedly not opposed the idea, focusing on benefits for future generations. EDF and governmental representatives assert that the visual impact from the beaches will be minimal and state that the project is proceeding with care to respect the area’s heritage.

Proyek puniki kaanggen olih EDF, perusahaan listrik utama ring Perancis, ngajinang turbin-turbin puniki kasengang ring limang titi pesisir segara Normandy, ngabisangang widang 330 mil persegi, sareng biaya kira-kira dasa juta pound. Salah satunya ring Courseulles-sur-Mer, sane dados tempat Juno Beach, ring tiosan pasukan Kanada sareng Inggris medal ring tanggal 6 Juni 1944. EDF ngerancangangang kapertamian proyek ring warsa 2015, prasida nyidayang ngidangang totalen nem gigawatt listrik setahun, sane mawakta kirang langkung 3,5% kabutuhan listrik Perancis. Ini dados bagian saking tujuan ageng Perancis ngajinang sumber energi terbarukan nylakarang duasa saking kabutuhan ring warsa 2030. Rencana puniki nyiptayang pamargin nanap. Sawetara warga sareng penggiat ngalanturang rasanang turbin prasida nganggen nilai sejarah kawasan punika. Claude Brevan sareng Jean-Louis Butre pinaka penglawan pisan sane nyidangangang rasanang turbin nenten ngormatin korban ring Perang Dunia II. Ring semeton sane sampun nenten ngidangangang opozisi, sapunika Anne d'Ornano, mantan anggota dewan, ngejelasin yening veteran-veteran Kanada lan warga lokal prasida makta projek puniki matemuang manfaat ring generasi anyar, selama sejarah kawasan puniki kaajengang. EDF sareng para pejabat mantenang yening pengaruh visual ring pesisir prasida pinaka alit, sareng nglaksanayang proyek puniki makta ajengan ring warisan sejarah kawasan puniki.

article_content: Mediacorp took home four Silver Dolphin awards at the 14th Cannes Corporate Media & TV Awards, held in Cannes, France. The accolades were given to CNA documentaries, each tackling significant themes. 'The Exiles: My Stolen Chinese Father,' previously honored at ContentAsia Awards 2023, won in the 'History and Personalities/Portraits' category. This documentary opens a two-part series on untold stories from post-war UK and Australia, focusing on the mysterious disappearances of Chinese seamen from Liverpool after World War II. 'A Million Cuts: India’s C-Section Epidemic' received the Silver Dolphin in the 'Human Concerns and Social Issues' category. Featuring in CNA's 'Undercover Asia' series, this documentary examines India's high rate of C-sections in private hospitals—47.4%, surpassing the WHO's recommended 15%—and the social factors behind this trend. The docudrama 'Riot Island: Prison In Flames' and the environmental film 'The Last Defenders,' both produced by Peddling Pictures, also received awards. 'Riot Island: Prison In Flames' follows the rise and fall of Pulau Senang, Singapore’s only open-air prison, exploring its reformative aims in the 1960s and the violent riot that marked its end. 'The Last Defenders' ventures into Southeast Asia’s rainforests to investigate deforestation and spotlight the dangers faced by wildlife, featuring conservationists combating poachers and criminal groups. Mediacorp CEO Tham Loke Kheng expressed pride and congratulated the teams, emphasizing the company’s commitment to authentic storytelling from an Asian viewpoint. The event drew almost 900 submissions from more than 45 countries, with the festival recognizing exceptional corporate films, online media, documentaries, and reports since 2010.

article_content: Although Hollywood is gradually making strides in promoting gender and racial diversity, there is still significant progress to be made—especially regarding new blockbusters written specifically for women. Notable trailblazers like Shonda Rhimes, Mindy Kaling, and Tina Fey continue to be the exception rather than the standard. Ongoing research confirms that women remain underrepresented on screen and behind the scenes. The idea to create a female-led version of 'Ghostbusters' got people thinking about other classic movies that could be reimagined with women as the stars. It's a playful and engaging exercise to picture, for example, a female Indiana Jones or a comedic duo reminiscent of Cheech and Chong, but with women in the roles. CNN involved its Facebook audience, resulting in an enthusiastic gallery of suggestions. You’re welcome to share your own ideas in the comments—just keep in mind that making a female version of 'Magic Mike' has already been well explored!

article_content: Rosanna Pansino, a popular baking and lifestyle YouTuber, has claimed she was unfairly omitted from recognition in a MrBeast ‘Creator Games’ video. The Creator Games, created by MrBeast (real name Jimmy), features internet personalities competing in large-scale challenges. Pansino asserts she earned third place in the 2021 ‘Extreme $1,000,000 Hide and Seek’ event, but the published video credited Logan Paul, Larray, and Zach King as the top finishers, leaving her out. She addressed the incident first on Trisha Paytas’ podcast ‘Just Trish,’ saying she delayed speaking out for fear of backlash from MrBeast's large fanbase. Pansino then posted a lengthy statement on X (formerly Twitter) where she expressed frustration, stating that MrBeast edited the video to downplay her performance, contrary to the show’s promise of authenticity. According to Pansino, the true ranking had Zach King first, Quackity second, and herself third. The event, held at SoFi Stadium, involved participants following strict hide-and-seek rules, including moving locations via walkie-talkie prompts or facing disqualification. Pansino reports she was offered money to quit but refused. She explains that Larray fell asleep and was disqualified, shifting her into the top three. Pansino, who was the only woman among the top finishers, says her achievement was not shown in the final video. When asked for proof, she referenced a 2022 video by Quackity supporting her recollection and fans circulated related clips. She states she has received support from both fans and other female creators with similar experiences. Both Pansino and MrBeast did not immediately comment further when contacted by the media.

article_content: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban has called on his nation to reject the current model of the European Union crafted in Brussels, arguing that meaningful reform is needed rather than withdrawal. Speaking at a Fidesz party event, Orban reiterated his strong opposition to beginning EU accession negotiations with Ukraine. He stated that Ukraine, which applied to join the EU shortly after Russia invaded in 2022, is not ready for membership. Orban also criticized EU strategies of providing financial and military support to Ukraine, claiming these efforts have produced poor results. Further, he pledged to oppose EU migration policies and what he labels 'gender propaganda.' The status of starting membership talks with Ukraine will be discussed at an EU summit next month, but Hungary’s resistance could prevent a unanimous decision among all 27 member states. In preparation, Hungary's government has sent out a survey asking citizens about their views on EU funding and Ukraine's membership. These moves come as Orban increases campaigning for the June 2024 European parliamentary elections. Ongoing disputes between Hungary and the EU include issues over frozen EU funds tied to concerns about Hungary's democratic standards. Orban’s Fidesz party has held power since 2010.

Ring acara partiné Fidesz, Orban ngulangang penolakan kerasné ring negosiasi akses anggota Uni Eropa sareng Ukraina. Ia maosang Ukraina, sane melutusang dados anggota sawatara Rusia ngelaksanayang invasi ring 2022, tusing siap dados anggota Uni Eropa. Orban nyidayang kritik ring kebijakan Uni Eropa ngaturang dana miwah bantuan militer ring Ukraina, maos punika sampun wenten indik hasil alit. Ia makta nglawan aturan migrasi Uni Eropa lan sane kadadosang ajengan 'propaganda gender.' Status negosiasi keanggotaan Ukraina alantur makta ajeng dados bahasan ring KTT Uni Eropa nak dura, sane prasida kasumbul ring penolakan sokongan Hungaria tur prasida ngalantur antuk titiang negara anggota. Pemerintah Hungaria sareng nglaksanayang survei ring warga sane nyantosang pendapat indik dana bantuan miwah keanggotaan Ukraina ring Uni Eropa. Kebijakan puniki nyarengin kampanye Orban ring pemilihan anggota parlemen Eropa ring Juni 2024. Konflik indik dana Uni Eropa sane kepending makta medal ring perhatian indik standarisasi demokrasi ring Hungaria. Partiné Orban sampun ngawit ngatur pemerintah ring tahun 2010.

article_content: A 37-year-old woman in Kambah, Canberra, faces $100,000 in repair bills after her newly purchased family home was vandalized by about 70 teenagers who organized a party via Facebook. The woman had recently acquired the four-bedroom house for $452,000 with her husband and 13-year-old son, and was in the midst of renovations when the incident occurred. The teenage group, believed to be between 15 and 18 years old, broke in around 9pm, causing extensive destruction: windows and doors were broken, holes kicked in the walls, fixtures smashed, and the house left littered with bottles of alcohol and tomato sauce. The family had just started decorating and was set to move in the following week. The homeowner reported being shocked when she arrived and saw seven police cars at the scene. Inside, she found smashed glass, damaged furnishings, paint thrown on the deck, and exposed wires in the kitchen. According to police, the destruction included broken windows, pulled-off doors, smashed light fittings, and damage to the backyard, characterizing it as a ‘senseless act of vandalism.’ Officers arriving shortly after the incident observed multiple vehicles and teenagers leaving the area. Police have noted several car registrations and are encouraging those responsible to come forward. The family, currently renting elsewhere, now faces months of repairs and is working with their insurance company. The homeowner, who wishes to remain unnamed, has appealed to the perpetrators to accept responsibility.

article_content: Dan Lambe is the CEO of the Arbor Day Foundation. He can be reached at dlambe@arborday.org. Follow him on Twitter at @DanLambe. In today's digital age, public perception plays a vital role, especially in the corporate sustainability arena. Opinions are formed quickly and spread even faster. Consumers are often skeptical of companies' environmental claims, partly due to well-publicized cases of 'greenwashing,' where some businesses have overstated the impact of their sustainability efforts. Fortunately, many corporate leaders are now adopting more responsible and rigorous approaches to setting ESG and sustainability goals. However, this progress can sometimes go unnoticed because of a phenomenon called 'green hushing.' Many brands choose not to share their environmental achievements to avoid possible negative public reactions. What is often overlooked is that staying silent may do more harm than good, affecting both business performance and climate progress. According to survey data from The Harris Poll, 71% of U.S. adults say they are more loyal to companies that actively work to protect the environment. Among younger consumers, 68% of those aged 18-34 are willing to pay more for products from companies with robust sustainability and climate stances. With climate change impacts becoming more serious, environmental stewardship is increasingly important, and consumers have noticed. The survey also found that 79% of Americans think corporations have a duty to address climate change, and 82% feel companies should reduce and offset carbon emissions. Now is not the time to downplay sustainability efforts; it’s important to engage leadership and openly recognize environmental achievements. You are not alone in efforts to improve the planet. A recent report from Climate Impact Partners found that 66% of Fortune Global 500 companies have well-defined climate goals, though many stay quiet about them. Greater openness could encourage broader corporate engagement in climate action. We need everyone’s involvement in meeting the challenge of climate change. Businesses shouldn’t be sidelined due to a lack of visible achievements. Consumers want to support companies committed to conservation, and climate action demands it. Some private sector leaders may be cautious about sharing their sustainability work immediately. To better connect your climate goals with your stakeholders, involve them in your journey. Communicate not only your end goals but also your plans, resources, and expert consultations. Provide regular updates to build trust through transparency and authenticity. Difficult questions from consumers are an opportunity for growth. Achieving a sustainable future will take collective effort. Remember, consumers are not your only audience. Sustainability projects also engage current and future employees. Involving them can foster a sense of ownership and purpose. The Harris Poll data also shows 73% of Americans believe companies discussing sustainability efforts are seen as leaders. Participating in climate actions like tree planting and reforestation can boost brand reputation and attract climate-conscious customers, bringing business benefits and more attention to vital environmental initiatives. It’s a win-win for corporations and the planet. Forbes Nonprofit Council is an invitation-only organization for chief executives in successful nonprofit organizations.

article_content: Federal Opposition Leader Bill Shorten addressed the Australian Christian Lobby (ACL) national conference in Canberra, telling attendees that he is both a Christian and a supporter of marriage equality. Shorten began his speech by quoting scripture, framing his remarks like a sermon. He urged the conservative Christian audience not to use religion as an instrument of exclusion or division. Shorten said that using scripture to attack blended families, demonize people for who they love, or claim that marriage equality leads to bestiality is unacceptable, stating, 'I cannot stay silent.' He emphasized that freedom of worship should not be used as an excuse to vilify others and that such prejudices do not reflect the Christian values he holds. His speech received mixed reactions. Some in the LGBT advocacy community criticized him for giving legitimacy to the ACL by speaking at their event, while others praised his stand. After his address, ACL Managing Director Lyle Shelton thanked Shorten for his 'fearless and frank' speech. Some government figures dismissed Shorten's remarks. Immigration Minister Scott Morrison stated that marriage equality was not currently being considered by the government, which was focused on national security and the economy. Liberal Senator Cory Bernardi, known for linking gay marriage to bestiality in the past, tweeted that no one took Shorten's comments on morality seriously. On the other hand, Liberal MP Josh Frydenberg noted there had been a shift in attitudes, and Australian Marriage Equality acting director Ivan Hinton-Teoh called Shorten's speech a powerful moment in history. However, Equal Marriage Rights Australia accused Shorten of hypocrisy for attending the ACL event after Labor's criticism of Liberal attendance at the World Families Congress, which the group considered 'extremely anti-gay.' Spokesman Ben Cooper called Shorten's attendance 'completely outrageous and extremely hypocritical.'

Pak Shorten ngamolihangang pidato-ne maosangang ayat suci, makta seakan-akan pesambrayan. Idane ngelingang audiens Kristen konservatif sampun makta agama dados alat sekat utawi memecah belah. article_content: After nine months on deployment in southwest Asia, Air Force Sergeant Wil Alteus made an early return to the United States to surprise his daughter, Lyrique. During Sgt. Alteus’s service, Lyrique, a second-grade student at Mount Dora Bible School in Florida, lived with her aunt Kinley. Neither Lyrique nor Kinley knew when Sgt. Alteus would return, making the surprise even more special. The school organized a trivia game resembling 'Wheel of Fortune,' inviting Lyrique and two classmates to participate. When the puzzle was solved and the message 'Lyrique’s dad is home' was revealed, Sgt. Alteus appeared in uniform at the back of the room. Overcome with emotion, Lyrique ran to hug her father as staff, students, and Kinley celebrated the reunion. According to Kinley, Lyrique was overjoyed and didn’t want to let her father go after their long separation. Mount Dora Bible School had previously facilitated special connections for the family: On Veterans Day, Sgt. Alteus joined a Skype call with Lyrique and more than 800 students and staff, marking another memorable moment during his deployment.

Wenten ring tugasne, Lyrique sane dados siswa kelas dua ring Sekolah Mount Dora Bible, Florida, melinggih sareng bucten Kinley. Lyrique sareng Kinley tusing nyidang apang apang yening bapane be balik, prasida dados kejutan sane majeng. article_content: Residents in Malmo, southern Sweden, are feeling anxious due to a series of shootings believed to be the work of a single attacker, with up to 15 cases in the past year suspected to be linked. The shooter appears to target immigrants and plans these attacks late at night in areas familiar to them. Police have yet to make an arrest. Multiple shootings have happened in the last few weeks. In one instance, two immigrant women were wounded when someone fired through their apartment window. Another resident, Shukrije Berisha, told Svenska Dagbladet she’s now afraid to turn on her lights at night. Other victims have included two men from ethnic minority backgrounds shot at bus stops; one survived a shot to his torso, and police think the assailant may have been hiding nearby before opening fire. Basi Hassan, a victim, described to TV4 how he heard a gunshot while waiting at the bus stop and quickly realized he was bleeding and felt dizzy. On Friday night, another incident occurred when an immigrant man reported being shot at while riding his bicycle. Authorities have responded by organizing a major investigation involving national and local police, as well as psychologists working to profile the perpetrator. Police patrols and K-9 units have been increased in the city. Safety fears are heightened in Malmo, where a significant proportion of the population are immigrants. For instance, Fatima, a 17-year-old local, told TV4 she no longer uses her bike or public transport due to fear, and she has trouble sleeping. The shootings recall Sweden’s 'Laser-man' attacks of the 1990s, which targeted immigrants in Stockholm. The Malmo superintendent Hans Nilsson noted this is the largest similar incident since then. A warning text about a killer on the loose has been circulating among Malmo’s youth. Although police state they are not behind this message, they understand the community’s concern. Malmo mayor Katrin Stjernfeldt Jammeh has voiced anger and insists it is unacceptable that residents have to fear for their safety.

article_content: Enrique Alberto Machado, a 36-year-old truck driver from Texas, has been charged with felony murder after the tragic death of his 13-month-old son, Carlos Enrique, on April 27 in Houston. Police reported that Machado fell asleep while bathing his son after driving over ten hours from Colorado to Houston and consuming six beers with colleagues. Carlos' mother, Cynthia Veliz, found her son unresponsive, floating face-up in the bathtub at her Houston home, while Machado was asleep nearby at around 11 a.m. Veliz shared that Machado had come to visit that morning and offered to bathe Carlos. She went back to bed but woke up to find the tragic scene. Veliz pulled Carlos out, woke Machado, and called 911. Machado tried to perform CPR, but it was too late. Carlos was pronounced dead at Texas Children's Hospital - West Houston Campus. Machado was charged with felony murder after Carlos' death was ruled a homicide. He appeared in court for a probable cause hearing. Prosecutors claimed Machado is in the U.S. illegally, but his lawyer stated Machado is documented and has been in Houston for 20 years. Machado's bond was set at $100,000.

Polisi ngaturangang yening Machado sampun mebat perjalanan langkung ring 10 jam saking Colorado magantos ring Houston lan ngombé 6 botol brem sareng reramaane, saksampun adusang anakné, ia ngalantur ngorahang di kamar mandi. Jaksa ngaturangang yening Machado sampun ring Amérika nenten resmi, nanging pengacaranya ngaturangang yening Machado sampun tinggal ring Houston 20 warsa. Bond ring Machado kasuratang $100,000.

article_content: Singaporean swimmer Toh Wei Soong won the country’s first medal at the Asian Para Games on Tuesday (Oct 24) in Hangzhou, China, clinching silver in the men’s 400m freestyle S7 final with a time of 5:12.15. The gold went to Ernie Gawilan from the Philippines, while China’s Huang Xianquan earned the bronze. This achievement marks Toh’s fourth Asian Para Games medal. In the 2018 edition in Jakarta, he secured two golds and a bronze. Earlier in 2023, at the ASEAN Para Games in Cambodia, Toh broke two Games records in the 50m and 100m S7 freestyle events and won five medals—three gold and two silver.

Emas wenten ring Ernie Gawilan saking Filipina, tur perunggu ring Huang Xianquan saking Cina. Prestasi puniki nglaksanayang medal kaping empat ring Asian Para Games ring Toh. Warsa 2018 ring Jakarta, ia ngametuang dua medal emas miwah satunggal perunggu. Ring warsa 2023 ring ASEAN Para Games ring Kamboja, Toh nyidayang nyetel dua rekor anyar ring 50m miwah 100m gaya bebas S7 tur ngametuang limang medal–tiga emas lan dua perak.

article_content: American artist and designer Jason Freeny, 43, is renowned for creating intricate anatomical sculptures that expose the internal structures of popular cartoon characters like Hello Kitty, Papa Smurf, Barbie, and Stewie Griffin from Family Guy. Freeny’s handmade and unique pieces—many currently on display in New York—showcase bones and organs beneath the familiar exteriors. Most of his sculptures are offered through his Moist Production website, with prices typically starting at £600 and reaching up to £5,000, highlighting their complexity and collectible status. Those seeking more affordable items can find designer pill fobs beginning at £5. Among his other creations is the Brain Cube Puzzle, a skull-themed reinterpretation of the classic Rubik’s Cube. Freeny studied Industrial Design at Pratt Institute in Brooklyn, New York. He spent much of the 1990s traveling as a muralist and theatrical designer before joining MTV’s Special Events department as a freelance designer in 1997. While at MTV, he contributed sets, props, and custom artwork for live events, notably designing awards for MTV’s 'Rock-n-Jock' series and 'TRL Awards.' Freeny’s first fictional anatomy illustration appeared in 2000, depicting the mythological Incubus, and his first anatomical sculpture debuted in 2010. Freeny enjoys making these pieces, believing realistic skeletal systems make the characters feel more lifelike. He hopes to create even larger versions in the future.

Patung unik puniki sane digawe tangan, iraga prasida nyidangang ring paméran ring New York, nampilin tulang lan organ ajeng sang tokoh. article_content:
Fawzia Mirza’s film, The Queen of My Dreams, takes a nuanced look at the often-turbulent relationships between mothers and daughters, with a focus on cultural identity and generational differences. The plot centers on Azra, a Pakistani Canadian woman who rebels against tradition by pursuing acting and embracing an LGBTQ lifestyle, causing friction with her parents, Miriam and Hassan. After her father's passing, Azra returns to Pakistan, which prompts a complicated reunion with her estranged mother. Through a series of vibrant flashbacks, viewers learn about Miriam’s own youthful independence and the challenges she faced adapting to Canadian life as an immigrant, including her efforts to earn a living selling tupperware. These storylines reveal the roots of their estrangement and offer hope for reconciliation through shared history.

The film distinguishes itself with vivid Bollywood-inspired visuals and affectionate references to iconic actress Sharmila Tagore. Fawzia Mirza’s direction radiates warmth and celebrates women's experiences across eras. While some may wish for deeper exploration of Azra’s present-day character, the narrative provides enough insight to appreciate her growth. Featuring performances by Amrit Kaur, Nimra Bucha, and Hamza Haq, The Queen of My Dreams runs for 1 hour and 37 minutes and delivers a heartfelt tribute to the trials and triumphs of families balancing tradition, identity, and forgiveness.

Carita puniki ngadadosang Azra, anak wadon Pakistani-Kanada sane nenten ngikuti tradisi, milih dados aktris lan ngidangang gaya urip LGBTQ. article_content: Former NBA star Dennis Rodman has claimed partial credit for the release of two U.S. citizens detained in North Korea. Rodman reported writing to North Korean leader Kim Jong-Un, his 'friend for life,' to plead for mercy in the case of Kenneth Bae, who had been in prison for six months. Bae and Matthew Miller have now been released and are reportedly returning home. In his letter—revealed earlier this year—Rodman expressed gratitude for Kim's mercy and praised improvements in North Korea, including new water parks and airport terminals. Rodman believes his diplomatic outreach and frequent visits to the country may have helped influence the releases, although he has been criticized in the U.S. for his relationship with Kim Jong-Un. Kenneth Bae, a Korean-American missionary detained in 2012 while leading a tour group in North Korea, had been sentenced to 15 years for alleged anti-government activities. Matthew Miller, from California, was serving a six-year term for espionage after reportedly tearing his visa and seeking asylum on arrival. Both were among the last Americans held in the country, following the earlier release of Jeffrey Fowle, an Ohio resident detained for nearly six months after reportedly leaving a Bible at a nightclub. The release was facilitated by U.S. Director of National Intelligence James Clapper, who accompanied Bae and Miller on their return trip. The U.S. government maintains there was no exchange or concession made for their release, and has thanked Sweden for its diplomatic role, as Sweden represents U.S. interests in North Korea. Experts suggest that North Korea may be releasing detainees as part of an effort to improve international relations or maintain communication channels, though U.S. officials deny any connection to President Obama's planned trip to Asia. The U.S. continues to express concern over North Korea's human rights record and nuclear program.

article_content: The first contestant viewers meet in Squid Game: The Challenge, a new reality competition inspired by the globally acclaimed South Korean Netflix thriller, is Starla, a relatable everywoman. 'Who isn’t in debt?' she asks, explaining her motivation for pursuing the $4.56 million prize awarded to the winner, calculated as 456 players competing for $10,000 each. However, Starla is eliminated during the very first round, highlighting the show’s brutal nature. Like the dramatic series it draws inspiration from—though without the violent consequences—the competition places hundreds of participants in high-stakes versions of childhood games. Netflix’s decision to rapidly adapt Hwang Dong-hyuk’s sharp critique of economic inequality into a reality format, coupled with significant public interest, suggests that the line between satire and reality is blurring. The show also reflects a wider shift in the reality TV genre toward cruelty and manipulation. Classic reality series such as Survivor, The Apprentice, and Big Brother were notorious for rewarding questionable behavior, while others like The Swan and Joe Millionaire exploited contestants’ vulnerabilities. Though the late 2010s brought a wave of friendlier reality series like The Great British Bake Off, Terrace House, and Netflix’s Queer Eye, recent years have seen a resurgence of harsher formats, including E!’s House of Villains and Netflix’s Surviving Paradise. The format ensures that contestants in Squid Game: The Challenge are aware of the demanding environment they are entering—meager rations, dormitory-style living reminiscent of a prison yard, and continuous twists that encourage betrayal among competitors. While the actual games can feel arbitrary, it is the interpersonal drama and conflict that drive the show, sometimes resulting in distressing scenes and heightened emotional stakes, especially when contestants share real-life bonds. Surviving Paradise complicates matters further by misleading participants into expecting luxurious accommodations, only for them to find themselves in a divisive, class-themed competition between 'insiders' enjoying comfort and 'outsiders' relegated to basic camp conditions and minimal food. Deceived by producers, players must betray each other for prize money, leading to petty disputes and escalating tensions. This trend of bait-and-switch concepts, popularized by earlier shows like Joe Millionaire and revived across platforms, is increasingly prevalent, particularly on Netflix. Series like Snowflake Mountain and Too Hot to Handle similarly entice contestants under false pretenses, before dramatically shifting the rules. Perhaps the clearest indicator that reality competitions have embraced their ruthless roots is the launch of House of Villains, which focuses on cunning strategy and social manipulation rather than more conventional forms of competition. Featuring well-known reality TV 'villains' such as Jonny Fairplay and Omarosa, the show places emphasis on psychological tactics, alliances, and betrayal. These dynamics are reinforced as less devious competitors, like Vanderpump Rules’ Jax Taylor, are the first to be eliminated. This evolution prompts questions about whether the so-called 'kind' era of reality TV was ever truly as positive as it seemed. There have been notable controversies, including a post-pandemic season of Top Chef where the winner was later fired following allegations of misconduct, a former Terrace House member’s suicide after online harassment, and criticism of Bake Off for cultural insensitivity. Ultimately, reality TV—whether gentle or cutthroat—is subject to extensive producer influence, with editing and casting designed to shape audience perceptions. Heroes and villains are often constructed in the editing suite, and narrative arcs are dictated by those behind the scenes. While the genre’s current embrace of cynicism and manipulation may be disheartening to some, it is not necessarily less authentic than past efforts to manufacture kindness.
translated_content: Peserta pertama yang dilihat pemirsa di Squid Game: The Challenge, ajang realitas baru terinspirasi thriller Korea Selatan Netflix, adalah Starla, wanita biasa yang mudah dipahami semua orang. 'Sapa sing tusing ngutang?' nyak Starla jelasin alasan berjuang demi hadiah 4,56 juta dolar (456 peserta × $10.000). Tapi, Starla langsung gugur di putaran pertama, nunjukin kerasnya acara ini. Mirip drama aslinya—tanpa kekerasan—kompetisi ini ngumpulin ratusan peserta di permainan anak-anak versi ekstrem. Netflix cepat mengadaptasi kritik tajam Hwang Dong-hyuk soal ketidaksetaraan ekonomi ke reality show, ditambah minat besar penonton, makin ngerancurin batas antara satire sama realita. Acara ini nunjukin perubahan tren reality show, balik ke pola kejam dan manipulatif. Reality show lama kayak Survivor, The Apprentice, dan Big Brother dulu malah ngasih penghargaan untuk perilaku buruk, sedangkan The Swan sama Joe Millionaire manfaatin kerentanan peserta. Meski sempat muncul era positif kayak The Great British Bake Off, Terrace House, dan Queer Eye di 2010an akhir, belakangan reality show 'jahat' muncul lagi, kayak House of Villains dan Surviving Paradise. Konsep acara pastiin peserta tahu risikonya: makanan seadanya, tidur di asrama seperti penjara, plus kejutan yang bikin peserta saling khianat. Permainan kadang acak, namun drama antar peserta yang menarik minat pemirsa—apalagi kalau ada hubungan pribadi. Surviving Paradise makin rumit—awalnya dijanjikan hidup mewah, ternyata cuman persaingan kelas; 'insider' nikmati kemewahan, 'outsider' cuma camping dan makan seadanya. Produser menipu, lalu peserta saling tikam buat uang, makin banyak konflik kecil yang bikin situasi panas. Tren tipu-tipu konsep kayak gini, yang dulu dimulai Joe Millionaire, sekarang makin sering ada—terutama di Netflix. Snowflake Mountain dan Too Hot to Handle juga undang peserta dengan janji palsu, lalu ganti aturan mendadak. Bukti jelas kompetisi TV makin kejam adalah kemunculan House of Villains, yang tonjolkan strategi sosial dan manipulasi. Bintang-bintangnya macam Jonny Fairplay dan Omarosa, dan yang kurang licik seperti Jax Taylor (Vanderpump Rules) malah cepat tersingkir. Perubahan ini bikin mikir: apa benar era reality TV 'baik' itu sebaik yang kita kira? Ada banyak kasus kontroversial, seperti pemenang Top Chef yang dipecat karena tuduhan pelecehan, anggota Terrace House yang mundur setelah cyberbullying, juga Bake Off yang dikecam soal budaya. Pada akhirnya, reality TV—baik yang lembut atau keras—diatur banget dari balik layar: pengeditan, pemilihan peserta, hingga nentuin siapa jadi pahlawan/penjahat. Sekarang reality show makin sinis dan manipulatif, tapi nggak lebih palsu dari era pura-pura ramah sebelumnya.

article_content: Lionel Messi's debut season in Major League Soccer with Inter Miami will not have a fairytale ending after the team was eliminated from playoff contention following a 1-0 home defeat to FC Cincinnati on Saturday. DC United also missed the playoffs, and shortly after, their English manager Wayne Rooney, a former Manchester United star, left the club by mutual agreement. Messi returned from injury as a substitute in the 55th minute, but Cincinnati, now the top seed in the playoffs, secured the match with a goal from Argentine Alvaro Barreal. Messi struggled to make an impact, missing two promising free-kick chances. Miami's coach Gerardo Martino noted Messi lacked match fitness due to recent injuries, which limited his time on the pitch. With other results not in their favor, Inter Miami sits next to last in the Eastern Conference, seven points behind the final playoff spot with only two matches remaining. Since September 3, Messi has played just 37 minutes for the club after returning from injury while on international duty with Argentina. Without Messi, Miami’s performance dipped, although they captured the Leagues Cup title in August—a highlight since his arrival in July. Saturday’s defeat was Miami’s second straight loss after a 4-1 setback at Chicago, and the team has only one win in its last six MLS matches. Messi appeared in that sole victory, going off early in a 4-0 win over Toronto. After their Leagues Cup triumph, expectations were raised for additional trophies, but without Messi the team lost the US Open Cup final to Houston and then fell out of the playoff hunt. Coach Martino, who took over just before Messi joined, acknowledged his expectations for the season were not fulfilled, though the Leagues Cup win was positive. Miami’s remaining games are against Charlotte, with Messi's availability uncertain due to his upcoming World Cup qualifying matches with Argentina. Meanwhile, DC United ended their season with a 2-0 victory over New York City FC, missing the playoffs. Minutes later, Rooney’s departure was announced. Rooney commented, 'It’s the right time. I’ve done everything I can to get this club into the playoffs. It's about timing.' In the Western Conference, five-time MLS champions LA Galaxy were also eliminated after a 5-2 defeat to Minnesota United. Teemu Pukki scored four second-half goals for Minnesota, who had dismissed coach Adrian Heath the previous day. Austin FC, last year's West finalists, also fell short after a 4-2 home loss to reigning champions LAFC, with Denis Bouanga scoring twice to become the league's leading scorer with 19 goals. Houston Dynamo, winners of the US Open Cup, improved their chances for a top-four finish, with Nelson Quinones scoring twice in a 5-1 win over Colorado.

article_content: Anthony Hamilton's 'Info Wing' is set for a series of design tweaks after a successful initial track test in Abu Dhabi. Force India used the LED display system atop one of their cars during the second day of the final test of the season at Yas Marina Circuit. Built to relay information from race control, the concept is intended to provide the viewing public with details like car position, tyre strategy, and track flag conditions. The Info Wing was placed above the driver’s head and tested by Force India in Abu Dhabi. The test helped Hamilton, whose son Lewis recently secured his second Formula One world title, identify areas that need improvement. Hamilton explained, 'As I suspected, the bright sunlight made it a bit difficult to see the LEDs when the cars were on track. In the garage they seemed bright enough, and at certain points on the circuit, they were visible. But we’ll probably need to change the LEDs, making them slightly larger and brighter.' The main issue observed was that the LED lights were hard to see in the intense sunlight. 'Overall, Force India thought it looked quite good and believe it will work well if we can increase the brightness a bit. You can test as much as you want in the UK, but we don’t have the same bright sunshine as in Abu Dhabi. Nevertheless, it was a good test and the prospects for the new version are promising,' Hamilton added. The next version of the system will feature a redesigned camera mount and a double-LED display, which can show both race position data and the first three letters of a driver’s surname. Once fully operational, the technology will be capable of displaying a range of information. Hamilton stated, 'Based on the feedback, we’re designing the new unit now, and I hope to have a new circuit board ready in three weeks. I’m going to persevere because, following last week’s story, there’s been significant interest. People love the idea, although some die-hard fans say it’s unnecessary. But it’s meant for all fans, not just the hardcore ones.' Hamilton is currently awaiting feedback from the FIA, the sport’s governing body.

article_content: Human Rights Watch (HRW) has stated that Israel's use of white phosphorus in military operations in Gaza and Lebanon puts civilians at serious risk, following an independent investigation. HRW verified video footage from Lebanon and Gaza showing multiple instances of artillery-fired white phosphorus over the Gaza City port and two rural areas near the Israel-Lebanon border. The organization also interviewed eyewitnesses who described attacks involving white phosphorus in Gaza. HRW said the use of white phosphorus in densely populated areas violates Israel’s obligation under international law to take precautions to avoid harming civilians. “Any use of white phosphorus in crowded civilian areas can cause severe burns and lifelong suffering,” said Lama Fakih, HRW’s director for the Middle East and North Africa. “White phosphorus is unlawfully indiscriminate when airburst over urban areas, where it may destroy homes and cause serious harm to civilians.” HRW called for a total ban on the use of airburst white phosphorus munitions in populated areas, citing the availability of non-lethal alternatives. Brian Castner, a weapons investigator with Amnesty International, agreed with HRW’s assessment that white phosphorus had been used. “White phosphorus does have some legitimate uses, such as marking and creating smoke screens, but these are rare,” Castner told Al Jazeera. “It should never be used in densely populated places, and Gaza is one of the most densely populated areas in the world.” On Friday, the Israeli military denied using white phosphorus in Gaza, stating, “The current accusation made against the IDF regarding the use of white phosphorus in Gaza is unequivocally false.” White phosphorus can cause deep, potentially fatal burns, and may be used in war for smoke screens, marking targets, or incinerating enemy positions. Although not globally banned in warfare, its use near civilians is prohibited by the United Nations Convention on Conventional Weapons, which Israel has not signed. Israel used white phosphorus extensively during its 2009 operations in Gaza, which drew widespread condemnation. In 2013, the Israeli military stated it would restrict the use of white phosphorus in populated areas except under exceptional circumstances, following a High Court petition. Israel has pledged to eliminate Hamas from Gaza after the group’s recent large-scale attack inside Israel. According to officials in Gaza, over 1,500 Palestinians have been killed and more than 6,600 wounded in Israeli airstrikes. Israeli officials report that more than 1,300 people were killed and 3,000 injured in Hamas’s multi-pronged attack on southern Israeli towns.

Organisasi puniki sarengang nyidangang wawancara ring saksi sane ngalanturangang serangan nganggon white phosphorus ring Gaza. Pejabat Israel rauh nyaritayang yening luwih saking 1.300 warga Israel mati miwah 3.000 luka ring serangan Hamas ring kota-kota selatan Israel.

article_content: Johnny Grant, the honorary mayor of Hollywood, was found dead Wednesday night, according to Los Angeles police. Grant was 84 years old and is believed to have died of natural causes. He was a well-known radio personality and television producer. Police said authorities discovered Grant in his bed at the Roosevelt Hotel, where he lived, around 7 p.m. Pacific Time (10 p.m. ET). Grant last spoke to his business manager Wednesday afternoon and mentioned he was feeling 'lousy,' according to Jim Harper, his manager for 60 years. Grant was especially recognized for his enthusiastic service as Hollywood's honorary mayor—a ceremonial title he held for over 50 years. He chaired the committee responsible for selecting stars for the Hollywood Walk of Fame and was frequently seen at celebrity handprint ceremonies at Grauman's Chinese Theatre.

Polisi ngureksain Grant kapanggihin ring jero kamare ring Roosevelt Hotel sane dados panggen nyipengne, kirang langkung jam 7 peteng waktu Pasifik (10 peteng ET). Grant nglaksanayang pesan ring manajer bisnisne Rahina Rebo siang lan nyantosin ngalantur merasa 'lousy', makudang ring Jim Harper sane sampun ngamargiang tugas ring Grant ring 60 warsa. article_content: Kapil Dev’s contributions to Indian cricket are unforgettable, with the 1983 World Cup victory reshaping the cricket landscape in the country. This triumph marked a pivotal moment, transforming how cricket was perceived and its significance in India. Kapil’s impact remains indelible, and he is regarded as one of the greatest cricketers India has ever produced. Kapil Dev's cricketing knowledge could benefit the current Indian team, but despite his achievements, the former captain prefers to 'detach' himself. Speaking on the TRS Podcast, Kapil revealed that the current Indian players have never sought his help—but he says it’s not their obligation to seek insights from him. "Not really. I don’t want to put myself in their position or tell them how to play. I just want to step back and watch them play," Kapil said. "No, the current players don’t reach out to me for help. Some might want to, but those who don’t, I can’t force them—they’re not obligated to do so. These kids are very smart, and they don’t need people like us. We are not better than them; we can only guide them to improve." In the recent World Cup, India dominated the Netherlands with a 160-run victory. Kapil also expressed admiration for Mohammed Shami and Jasprit Bumrah, acknowledging their crucial roles in India's unbeaten journey to the semifinals. "I think Shami is extraordinary. Bumrah, with his unique action—hats off to him. I couldn’t imagine anyone being as effective as him with such a short run-up and unusual bowling style. They have the experience—they just need to keep themselves fit," he added. India is considered the favorite against New Zealand in the upcoming semifinal, which will be a repeat of the final-four clash from the 2019 World Cup.

Tiang nenten ngidang nyidang ngelaksanayang tugas ring posisine anak-anak puniki utawa nyarengin nyak ngelaksanayang cara asiki. Tiang cuman ngorahang sareng nyanggraangang nonton dane main. Nenten wenten pemain nyantosangang tiang. Yen wenten nyantosangang, dados; yen ten wenten, ten dados kasuratangang, ten wenten kewajiban. Anak-anak puniki pinaka cerdas, nenten nglaksanayang ring kami. Tiang ten luwih becik, tiang cuman bisa ngametuang tuntunan nglaksanayang sareng becik." Ring World Cup sane anyar, India ngalahangang Belanda antuk galah 160 run. Kapil taler nglaksanayang ring Mohammed Shami sareng Jasprit Bumrah, nglaksanayang peran utama ring perjalanan tanpa kalah ring semifinal. "Tiang paling uli Shami pinaka luar biasa. Bumrah ring gaya sane unik—suksma tur ngidang kalaksanayangangang. Nenten kaidang nyidang wenten sane manten kuat ring ring run-up teteg ngelaksanayang gaya sane tiosan. Wenten pengalaman, tinggal nglaksanayang sehat," jelas Kapil. India pinaka favorit ring semifinal nglawan New Zealand, sane dados ngulang pertandingan semifinal World Cup 2019.

article_content: European football is at the forefront of sports news, showcasing major wins for Real Madrid and Barcelona. In an interview with Marca, Real Madrid's James Rodriguez stressed the importance of teamwork in defense and hailed Cristiano Ronaldo as unmatched by any rival. These remarks followed Real's 18th straight victory, a 3-0 win over Celta Vigo. Rodriguez singled out Ronaldo for his record 23rd La Liga hat-trick, describing the gap between him and other players as enormous. At the same time, Mundo Deportivo spotlighted Barcelona's spectacular 5-1 victory against Espanyol, fueled by Lionel Messi's hat-trick. Messi's display was described as both decisive and 'stratospheric.' This win keeps Barcelona close behind Real Madrid—just two points adrift—in the La Liga table. Across Italy, La Gazzetta dello Sport covered a tough weekend for Milan’s clubs: AC Milan lost 1-0 to Genoa while Inter Milan were beaten 2-1 at home by Udinese, leaving manager Roberto Mancini still searching for his first win since his return. AC Milan currently stand eighth in Serie A, four spots above Inter. In Portugal, A Bola reported that Nani—currently on loan to Sporting Lisbon from Manchester United—picked up a thigh injury during Sporting's 3-1 victory over Boavista, potentially sidelining him until 2015.

article_content: Actor-dancer Raghav Juyal recently shared his experience of receiving a surprise call from Salman Khan about joining the film 'Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan' (KKBKKJ). Raghav, who played Salman’s brother in the movie, revealed that he nearly missed answering the call as he believed it was a prank at first. In an interview with Bollywood Bubble, Raghav recounted, 'This is the one film for which I didn’t audition. Bhai (Salman Khan) contacted me directly. I was on another movie set when my assistant informed me that Salman bhai was calling. I initially said I’d call back later because I thought it was someone else with the same name, a dancer from our community. My assistant clarified it was the famous Salman Khan. I then answered, and he told me about the film.' Raghav explained that he assumed it might just be a casual call or even a prank, but it turned out to be genuine. Raghav was shooting for both KKBKKJ and Guneet Monga’s 'Kill' at the same time. He mentioned that he prepared for 'Kill' for nine months, whereas 'KKBKKJ' did not require much preparation. He recalled, 'We just had to arrive on time and the shoot would take care of itself.' KKBKKJ featured Shehnaaz Gill, Pooja Hegde, Palak Tiwari, Siddharth Nigam, among others. The film did not perform strongly at the box office. For more updates and Bollywood news, visit The Indian Express.

Raghav sane ngelaksanayang perang dados adine Salman ring film puniki rauh ngidang nyantosang telponne taler prasida nenten nyaut ring telpon punika prasida ngecaraang punika adalah ngelaksanayang lelucon. Tiang prasida ngidang nyantosang dados, malih tiang nyantosang nenten prasida ngajengang telpon, nenten prasida nyaut, prasida silih sinamian dados sane ngidang ngajengangang napi punika ajengan, utawi dansa ring komunitas. Asisten tiang malih ngaturangang puniki ring ajengan Salman Khan sane tenar. Tiang prasida nyaut telponne, sarengajengan nyarengin ring film punika.' article_content: EDINBURG, Texas (AP) — Former President Donald Trump received the endorsement of Texas Governor Greg Abbott on Sunday during a visit to Edinburg, a town near the U.S.-Mexico border. Trump promised that his approach to border security, if elected to a second term, would allow Abbott to focus on other priorities in Texas. Both appeared before a crowd of about 150 people at an airport hangar. Abbott, a Republican and longtime supporter of Trump, stated, “We need a president who’s going to secure the border,” referencing Edinburg’s proximity to the Hidalgo Port of Entry. He added, “We need Donald J. Trump back as our president.” Earlier in the day, Trump and Abbott served meals to members of the Texas National Guard, state troopers, and others stationed at the border over Thanksgiving. They handed out tacos, greeted personnel, shook hands, and posed for pictures. Trump told the service members, “What you do is incredible, and you want it to be done right.” Abbott remarked that these personnel “should be at home,” and argued they are only at the border due to what he called insufficient federal border security. Trump reiterated his arguments for stronger immigration policies. Although his remarks in Edinburg were brief, he highlighted his belief in border walls, stating, “We just need the walls. And it worked.” His policy proposals for another term include expanding the border wall, reviving and expanding the travel ban (which initially targeted Muslim-majority countries), instituting ideological screenings for immigrants, and targeting those with alleged extremist connections for deportation. Trump also discussed using the Alien Enemies Act to remove known or suspected gang members and drug dealers, ending birthright citizenship for most children of non-citizens via executive order, and cutting off funding for shelter and transportation for migrants present in the country illegally. He supports reimplementing measures such as Title 42 and proposes severe penalties for human traffickers, including the death penalty. Trump wants to shift federal law enforcement resources to focus on immigration enforcement. The visit comes as Abbott is preparing to sign a strict new Texas law allowing state police to arrest migrants suspected of illegal entry and give judges the power to effectively deport them—a move seen as challenging federal immigration authority. Mexico has already criticized this measure. The endorsement highlights occasional tensions within the GOP. While Abbott enjoys broad support in Texas, he has faced criticism from hard-right conservatives and was previously booed at a Trump rally. However, Abbott has succeeded in expanding GOP support among Texas Hispanic voters. Democrats criticized Trump’s plans as extreme. Biden campaign manager Julie Chavez Rodriguez said, “Donald Trump is going after immigrants, our rights, our safety, and our democracy.” Recent polling from Marquette Law School found Trump with a sizable lead over Biden among voters on immigration and border security. Reporting contributed by Jill Colvin in New York and Will Weissert in Wilmington, Delaware.

Trump rauh makta ring panureksaine nglaksanayang indik ngaweti perbatasan, pinaka presiden kedadosang kalih, dadosang Abbott prasida makarya indik hal-hal sane lianan ring Texas. Sakewala wenten 150 taler miwahang pararama ring hangar bandara. Abbott, Republican sareng dados panyarengin Trump sane tiosin, nyarengin, "Iraga prasida presiden sane prasida ngaweti perbatasan," makta ring Edinburg sane prasida ring Hidalgo Port of Entry. I punika makta, "Iraga prasida dados presiden Amérika Serikat indik Donald J. Trump." Ring rahina puniki, Trump sareng Abbott dados nglaksanayang ngidangang ajengan ring anggota Texas National Guard, polisi nagara, sareng sane wenten ring perbatasan ring wulan Thanksgiving. I punika ngeleden taco, ngerereh ajengan, malu sareng personél, miwahang poto sareng. Trump ngaturangang prasida indik politik imigrasi sane keras. Senajana wantah makta ring Edinburg prasida sing patet, i prasida ngaturang indik tembok perbatasan, ngidangang: "Iraga prasida tembok. Lan punika dados becik." Planning politik ring masekalih prasida ngalaksanayang ngluwahang tembok perbatasan, nguripang travel ban (utamanya ka negara-negara Muslim), nglaksanayang screening ideologi, sareng ngusir sane nyantosang ekstremis. Trump prasida ngererehang Alien Enemies Act indik ngusir anggota geng sareng pengedar narkoba, nguripang hak kelahiran warga negara ring anak anak saking orang tua sane nenten warga Amérika, sareng nglimbakang panulak ajengan sareng transportasi ring migran sane tusing sah legal. I wantah ngidangang indik nganutang Title 42, sareng makakasami nyarengin hukuman mati ring nyantosang trafficker wanita sareng anak-anak. Trump prasida nangkep aparat hukum federal prasida ngidangang ngeranjing ring imigrasi. Kunjungan puniki wantah ring waktu Abbott prasida ngajengang undang-undang keras anyar ring Texas, dadosang polisi nagara prasida nyidangang migran sane nyidangang tanpa ijin sareng kadadangang hakim ngusir ring negara. Meksiko sampun ngaturang kritik ring kebijakan puniki. Dukungan puniki wantah makapang ketegangan ring GOP. Abbott prasida ajengan ageng ring Texas, nanging prasida wenten kritik saking konservatif keras sareng prasida dados ring acara Trump. Nanging, Abbott prasida prasida nyidayang nambah ajengan GOP ring pemilih Hispanik ring Texas. Demokrat nyarengin politik Trump pinaka ekstrim. Manajer kampanye Biden, Julie Chavez Rodriguez, ngidangang, "Donald Trump prasida ngusir imigran, hak iraga, keamanan iraga, sareng demokrasi iraga." Polling saking Marquette Law School ngidangang Trump prasida ngidang ajengan ring Biden indik imigrasi lan keamanan perbatasan. Puniki ring laporan olih Jill Colvin ring New York sareng Will Weissert ring Wilmington, Delaware.

article_content: A summer night of music at the Mountain Winery near San Jose ended in tragedy when Michael Edward Pickels, 32, died by suicide during a Swell Season concert. He left his belongings with a friend before appearing unexpectedly on the stage roof and jumping from about 35 to 40 feet, landing near the band’s lead singer. Sheriff’s Office spokesperson Rick Sung said that medical professionals on site performed CPR for nearly 30 minutes, but Pickels was pronounced dead at the scene. Pickels had been out on $150,000 bail, facing charges from a New Year’s Day incident that included assault with a firearm, domestic violence, and false imprisonment. According to officials, Pickels had restrained his girlfriend and threatened to kill both of them before she convinced him to stop and contacted law enforcement. He eventually surrendered after a standoff. The coroner confirmed the cause of death as suicide. The Mountain Winery—patrolled by local deputies outside and by its own staff inside—issued a brief statement online about the incident, offered condolences, and said that concerts would continue as scheduled. The Swell Season expressed shock and sorrow on social media, sharing that they were grieving alongside the community and hoped their ongoing performances would provide some solace. They extended their sympathies to Pickels’ family and friends.

Pamedalang saking kantor Sheriff, Rick Sung, nglaksanayang yening tim medis nglakonin CPR ajak kirang langkung 30 menit, nanging sampun kapastika Pickels matilarang ring tempat kejadian. Pickels prasida dados tahanan ring jaminan $150,000 indik kasus Warsa Anyar sane ngalanturang dudonan kekerasan indik senjata, kekerasan rumah tangga, miwah nyidayang ngurung tan wenten kabuktian. Miturut petugas, Pickels ngidang ngeranjingang pacange ring ancaman, nanging kacang prasida nyaketi, lan nglaksanayang negosiasi tur nyerah ring petugas. Koroner ngawahangang yening sabab matilarang wenten nyujati urip. Mountain Winery sane ngayahang keamanan ring jaba ajak petugas lokal, ngaturangang pernyataan ring online tur ngaturangang duka, tur acara konser tetap lanjut ring jadwal sane sampun kasuratang. The Swell Season ngalanturang rasa kaget tur sedih ring media sosial, tur wantah konser sane kalaksanayang sane dados panglipur ring soroh masyarakat, ngawitang duka ring kulawarga miwah rerama sane kinantenin.

article_content: Nigerian striker Gift Orban is no longer the most valuable player in the Belgian Jupiler Pro League, according to Transfermarkt. As of June, Orban was valued at €20 million, topping the Belgian league. However, Antwerp midfielder Arthur Vermeeren has now taken the top spot with a value of €25 million. Following Vermeeren is Club Brugge’s Norwegian forward of Nigerian descent, Antonio Nusa, listed at €20 million. Nusa has scored twice and provided three assists in 13 appearances across all competitions this season, and saw his market value increase by €16 million. Gift Orban, whose impressive start at Gent slowed after a much-anticipated transfer failed to materialize in the summer, is now the third most valuable player in Belgium. Completing the top five are Andreas Olsen and Bilal El Khannouss, both valued at €18 million. Orban is currently enduring the longest goal drought of his career, failing to score in nine consecutive games: six in the Jupiler Pro League, two in Europa Conference League qualifying rounds, and one in the group stage. He has managed just two goals in nine league matches this season – six in 15 games across all competitions – a stark contrast to his previous scoring record of 45 goals in 61 games since arriving in Europe over a year ago. Having joined Gent from Norwegian club Stabaek for €3.5 million in January, Orban remains under contract with the club until June 30, 2027. He is expected to feature in Gent’s Europa Conference League match against Breioablik of Iceland.

Nanging, pemain tengah Antwerp, Arthur Vermeeren, sampun nglancengin posisi pinaka ajeg regane ring angka €25 yuta. Saking Vermeeren, inggih punika pemain depan Club Brugge saking Norwegia sane keturunan Nigeria, Antonio Nusa, pinaka urutan kalih ring €20 yuta. Nusa sampun maktaang kalih gol lan nyidaangang tiga assist ring 13 pertandingan ring indik kompetisi musim puniki, miwah regane nambah olih €16 yuta. Gift Orban, sane preside dados start gemilang ring Gent nanging performane merosot saking transfer ageng sane nenten kelaksanayang ring musim panas, dados pinaka pemain tiga ring regane ring Belgia. Orban saat puniki ngalanturang paceklik gol ring karirne, nenten maktaang gol wantah ring sangang pertandingan berturut-turut: nem ring Jupiler Pro League, kalih ring kualifikasi Europa Conference League, lan silih ring fase grup. Ring musim puniki, ia maktaang kalih gol ring sangang pertandingan liga – nem gol ring 15 laga ring indik kompetisi – jauh saking catatan 45 gol ring 61 pertandingan preside ring Eropa. article_content: Ante Simundza, Maribor’s head coach, hopes to find any weaknesses in Chelsea’s game as his team faces the undefeated Premier League leaders in the Champions League Group G on Tuesday night. Having come through the qualifiers, Maribor drew with both Sporting Lisbon and Schalke in their first two games. Simundza said Maribor always tries to win and prefers to play attacking football. However, he acknowledged the challenge ahead, describing Chelsea as a highly competitive side who are favorites not just in the group but in the tournament overall. He emphasized that every team has strengths and weaknesses, and Maribor would look to take advantage where possible. They enter the match after suffering their first defeat in nine games—a 2-1 loss to Celje due to two own goals by Aleksander Rajcevic. The team is preparing hard for their away test at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea will be missing star striker Diego Costa because of injury. Still, Simundza doesn't expect this absence to give Maribor a significant advantage, pointing out Chelsea’s strength in depth. Defender Marko Suler echoed this, saying he’d enjoy the challenge of facing Costa but believes Chelsea remain strong regardless. Maribor earned their group stage place by eliminating Celtic but recognize the higher level Chelsea represents. Suler commented that Chelsea is their hardest opponent so far and that Maribor will try their best to challenge them, despite Chelsea being clear favorites.

Maribor yang harus melalui babak kualifikasi berhasil meraih hasil imbang melawan Sporting Lisbon dan Schalke pada dua laga pertamanya. Simundza menjelaskan bahwa Maribor selalu berusaha menang dan memilih bermain secara ofensif. Namun, dia juga mengakui bahwa Chelsea sangat kompetitif dan menjadi favorit di grup dan turnamen ini. Menurutnya, setiap tim pasti punya kelebihan dan kekurangan, dan Maribor akan berusaha memanfaatkan setiap peluang yang ada. Jelang laga ini, Maribor baru saja mengalami kekalahan pertamanya dalam sembilan pertandingan—kalah 2-1 dari Celje akibat dua gol bunuh diri Aleksander Rajcevic. Timnya sudah mempersiapkan diri dengan baik untuk laga tandang ke Stamford Bridge. Chelsea tidak bisa menurunkan striker andalan mereka, Diego Costa, karena cedera. Namun, Simundza tidak menganggap absennya Costa sebagai keuntungan besar karena Chelsea tetap punya banyak pemain kuat. article_content: BENGALURU: A hearing-impaired candidate has lodged a complaint against the Department of Collegiate Education and the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA), alleging improper implementation of reservation and roster systems during the recruitment of assistant professors in first grade colleges. The selection list was released in March.  The complaint was filed by Shailesh Krishna, who has a congenital hearing disability, at the Karnataka Administrative Tribunal (KAT). Shailesh holds a postgraduate degree in English and is currently pursuing his PhD.  According to Shailesh, when KEA conducted recruitment in 2015, there were 2,160 posts, of which seven were reserved for persons with disabilities. Four were designated for general merit-physically handicapped (GM-PH) candidates and three for physically handicapped (PH) candidates from other categories.  Shailesh claims that although four GM-PH candidates were selected, three of them secured high ranks through general merit, leaving GM-PH reserved posts unfilled. By reservation policies, such vacancies should be carried forward to the next recruitment cycle.  In 2021, a fresh notification announced 1,242 assistant professor vacancies. Shailesh alleges that only the three PH-reserved seats from 2015 were carried forward, while the GM-PH seats were omitted. He asserts that eight seats should have been included in the 2021 list, but only five were.  When the final selection list was published on March 3, Shailesh’s name was absent. article_content: The Mumbai Fire Brigade (MFB) responded to 280 emergency calls during this year's Diwali period (November 9-15), with 79 incidents related to firecracker use. Diwali was celebrated across India on November 12, while Diwali Padwa (Balipratipada), observed on November 14, was marked with large celebrations throughout Maharashtra. According to MFB officials, the 79 firecracker-related calls this year marked a significant increase compared to 65 in 2021 and 37 in 2022. Of the 280 total calls, two were classified as level one emergencies—which require the deployment of at least four fire engines—while one incident was deemed level two, prompting the response of eight fire engines. Breakdown data shows 27 firecracker-related calls on November 12 (Diwali), 19 on November 14, and 13 on November 13. The high number of such calls occurred despite strict directives from the Bombay High Court issued to address the city's worsening air quality. On November 12, 78 calls were recorded, followed by 68 on November 13 and 43 on November 15, MFB data reveals. During this period, a 95-year-old woman died in a fire at an 11-storey building in Vile Parle, and four people were injured in separate incidents. On Laxmi Puja day, at least 27 fire incidents occurred in Mumbai, including a case where a rocket entered the balcony of a 13th-floor flat in Jogeshwari West. In related news: The Indian Medical Association (IMA) in Bihar has called for a strike on November 21 to protest an attack on a doctor in Purnia. Private and government hospital doctors, along with medical colleges and nursing homes, will refrain from duty—emergency services remain unaffected. A meeting on November 22 will determine further actions. Additionally, the IMD has issued a yellow alert for Mumbai, Thane, and Palghar for November 25-26, forecasting unseasonal rain with thunderstorms, lightning, and high winds due to a weather trough near the Bay of Bengal. These rains may help improve Mumbai's air quality.

article_content: A stunning sunset marked the last the researchers at the remote Concordia station in Antarctica will see for three months. Operated by the European Space Agency (ESA), the base’s staff now face an extended period under artificial lighting. The team acknowledges that the months of darkness are difficult, but say that the magnificent view of the stars more than makes up for it. The French–Italian Concordia station supports research in glaciology, human biology, and atmospheric science. ESA uses the base to prepare for future long-duration space missions. During the Antarctic winter, Concordia experiences near total darkness, with average temperatures at –51°C and lows reaching –85°C. This unique, extreme environment provides a setting for studying the effects of isolation on small, multicultural teams. Crewmember Antonio Litterio shared his impressions: 'The night brings darkness, which could inspire fear, but also offers an incredible spectacle—the stars, the Milky Way, and even more amazing, the aurora.' He remarked on witnessing the aurora for the first time: 'Suspended over my head, a green, living, moving trail extended from the horizon. My visor fogged up and I removed it; the cold stung my eyes, though there was no pain. Despite the discomfort, I stayed watching that high-in-the-sky light longer.' He continued, 'Once back inside and under the blankets, I was too astonished to sleep. The view of my first aurora was unforgettable.' At night after the last sunset, the Concordia base becomes one of the coldest places on Earth, with summer temperatures barely above –25°C (–13°F) and winter temperatures dropping as low as –80°C (–112°F). The base is built and prepared each year to run self-sufficiently for most of the year. Other regions above the Arctic Circle, including areas of Finland, Norway, and Russia, also experience extended periods of daylight and darkness. For example, in some parts of Finland, the sun doesn’t set for 73 days during summer, while in Norway, 24-hour daylight occurs from April 19 through mid-August. During winter, these areas have 'polar nights,' without sunrise, while near the Arctic Circles 'white nights' produce continuous twilight. St. Petersburg, Russia, celebrates its white nights with ten-day festivals at the end of June. Food, fuel, and other supplies are brought in by land and air prior to the winter. The last supply plane leaves in February, marking the beginning of complete isolation. Even as temperatures plummet and darkness prevails for nearly four months, the Concordia crew continue valuable climate observations. According to ESA, this year’s winter crew is almost at full capacity, with all but one bed filled by scientists and technicians—including astronomers, glaciologists, seismologists, and a meteorologist—supported by essential staff such as a plumber, electrician, mechanic, and cook. The base is also hosting medical doctor Evangelos Kaimakamis from Greece, who is conducting eight experiments to prepare for future space missions. These studies address issues such as morale, efficiency, and health effects in environments similar to space. ESA also notes that new materials for human spacecraft are tested at Concordia. The Concordia base is constructed every year using specially shipped materials and is prepared to support its team throughout the extreme Antarctic winter.
