article_content: Across Pennsylvania’s Lehigh Valley, control of local school boards has become a focal point in the upcoming November election. During a Halloween event in downtown Coopersburg, Doug Durham—a candidate for the Southern Lehigh school board—distributed candy while encouraging participation from all voters, regardless of political affiliation. School board races that once focused on issues like taxes and teacher pay have shifted to debates around ‘parental rights’ and curriculum concerns. Durham is part of the ‘True Republicans,’ a group backed by the county GOP. Their candidates signed a pledge to review curriculums for ‘woke politics,’ which critics have framed as an attempt to censor school libraries. Durham clarified on local radio that he opposes book banning and supports free speech but believes schools shouldn’t provide children access to material he deems pornographic. The group’s pledge also includes restricting bathroom access to a student’s assigned sex at birth and notifying parents when students request a name or pronoun change. Durham argues that parental involvement is critical for students’ well-being, while opponents maintain student privacy and trust with educators is also essential. Emily Gehman, an incumbent school board member running for reelection as part of a moderate and bipartisan slate, refused to sign the pledge, arguing that immediate parental notification requirements can cause more harm than good. Political science professor Dan Hopkins of the University of Pennsylvania observed that the pandemic helped nationalize local school board politics, with parents becoming more directly involved in education decisions. Organizations like Moms for Liberty and Stop Moms for Liberty now influence local campaigns, bringing national political divides into community debates. Parents such as Christine Slifer say the school board race’s divisiveness has spread online and overshadowed recognition of Southern Lehigh’s academic strengths. Reporting by Sarah Mueller, Lehigh Valley News.

article_content: Tropical forests are absorbing more carbon dioxide than scientists previously believed, according to a NASA-led study. Researchers found that these forests take up about 1.5 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually through photosynthesis and growth, which is far more than is absorbed by the vast boreal forests circling the Arctic. The findings highlight that rainforests, such as the Amazon, are essential for removing excess greenhouse gases and play a much larger role in the global carbon cycle than previously recognized. Dr. David Schimel of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, who led the study, said: 'This is good news because carbon uptake in boreal forests is already slowing, while tropical forests may continue to take up carbon for many years.' Deforestation in the Amazon, the world's largest rainforest, decreased by 18% over the past year. Brazil reported that 4,848 square kilometers (1,870 square miles) of rainforest were destroyed between August 2013 and July 2014, compared to 5,891 square kilometers (2,275 square miles) during the previous period. This is roughly an area larger than the US state of Rhode Island. This decrease follows Brazil's adoption of a revised Forest Code in 2012, which eased restrictions for some landowners, especially those with smaller properties, allowing them to clear land closer to riverbanks. Clearing of rainforest accounts for about 75% of Brazil's emissions, as felled trees are burned or decay. The Amazon stretches across 6.1 million square kilometers (3.8 million square miles), with more than 60% within Brazil. However, Dr. Schimel and colleagues caution that ongoing deforestation in tropical rainforests could worsen climate change by increasing atmospheric carbon dioxide. Overall, the study estimates forests and other vegetation globally absorb around 2.7 billion tons of CO2, about 30% of human emissions. Higher atmospheric CO2 is helping forests worldwide grow faster, but the rate and amount absorbed have been difficult to estimate with conflicting study results. Previously, mature rainforests were thought to absorb little carbon dioxide, since younger, faster-growing trees take up more CO2 as they grow. Earlier data suggested tropical forests were releasing more CO2 than they absorbed due to deforestation. The new study, however, indicates tropical forests are absorbing more carbon dioxide and growing more rapidly than earlier believed. Schimel’s team used computer models, satellite data, field measurements, and photosynthesis experiments to understand how forests absorb atmospheric CO2. NASA satellites monitor rainforest changes, like in the Amazon, to estimate carbon uptake. Dr. Schimel said: 'Previously, there seemed a contradiction between small-scale carbon dioxide fertilization theory and global-scale observations. This study offers a hypothesis that better explains photosynthesis both microscopically and planet-wide. All else being equal, higher temperatures mean stronger effects in the tropics than in boreal forests.' Still, he warned that climate-driven changes in water supply and continued deforestation could reduce tropical forests’ ability to absorb carbon dioxide. He concluded: 'To keep the global carbon cycle working as it does, tropical forests need to be protected from destruction.' Contrary to prior belief that rainforests are poor absorbers of CO2, this study shows they account for over half of all greenhouse gases taken up by global vegetation.

article_content: Joshua Chamberlain’s Medal of Honor, awarded for his valor at Gettysburg, has been returned to his hometown museum after being unexpectedly discovered at a church sale. Presented to Chamberlain by President Grover Cleveland in 1893—decades after the Civil War—the medal has come back to Maine just in time for the 150th anniversary of the renowned battle. An anonymous finder spotted the medal inside a book and sent it to the Pejepscot Historical Society, which is based in Chamberlain’s old home in Brunswick. Initially, museum staff doubted the medal's authenticity, but experts from the Smithsonian and the Army verified it was Chamberlain's original Medal of Honor. Chamberlain participated in at least 24 battles during the Civil War, suffered multiple injuries, and is best known for leading the Union defense of Little Round Top on the battle’s second day. Following Chamberlain’s death in 1914, the medal remained in his family until his granddaughter Rosamund Allen died in 2000. Her estate was given to Duxbury Church, which unknowingly sold the medal hidden in a book. Jennifer Blanchard, from the historical society, shared heartfelt thanks for the anonymous donor, noting the importance of the medal to Maine and Chamberlain’s history. The museum kept the medal’s return under wraps until experts confirmed its authenticity, timing the reveal with the community’s annual Chamberlain Day festivities.

She was seen confidently moving about on crutches and with a leg brace soon after the incident.

Several relatives of individuals who died in the September 11 attacks have formally requested the names and addresses of other victim families, aiming to coordinate opposition to the city's plan to store unidentified remains in a museum repository at ground zero. A spokesperson for Mayor Michael Bloomberg firmly stated that the city would not release private information, citing privacy concerns.

Seventeen family members filed a Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) request to contact other families and involve them in the decision regarding the remains. They argue that families were not adequately informed or consulted about the plan, which they suspect could commercialize their loved ones' remains as part of a tourist attraction. Rosemary Cain, whose son George was a firefighter lost on 9/11, stressed that families should have the final say over the remains’ resting place.

Over half of the families have never received any remains, while some have only received fragments. More than 9,000 still-unidentified body parts are held by the Office of the Chief Medical Examiner. The current city plan would relocate these remains to an underground chamber at the museum being constructed at the original World Trade Center site, with oversight from the medical examiner’s office in hopes that advancements in DNA technology will eventually enable more identifications.

The National September 11 Memorial and Museum maintain that family members were included through a series of meetings and public comment opportunities, and that many families supported returning the remains to the original site’s bedrock. Plans include a private area exclusively for families, with individual after-hours visitation available.

Despite this, some, including retired fire chief Jim Riches, felt misled, stating they expected the remains to be placed separately from the museum, and favoring a memorial similar to the above-ground Arlington National Cemetery Tomb of the Unknowns. At a recent press conference, others echoed that they were not properly notified of the current arrangement.

Museum officials say that above-ground memorials bring security challenges and could encourage disrespectful behavior, supporting the underground option. Attorney Norman Siegel, representing the families, asserts there is no evidence of official notice being sent to families about the repository plan. Similarly, Rosaleen Tallon, whose brother died on 9/11, received letters about name spellings but, she said, never about the treatment of remains—a communication she believes was necessary.

article_content: Dallas Cowboys linebacker Jerry Brown lost his life early Saturday morning in a car accident in Irving, Texas. His teammate and close friend, Josh Brent, was driving at the time and has been charged with intoxication manslaughter. The crash occurred when Brent’s vehicle struck a curb and flipped, leading to Brown being found unresponsive and later pronounced dead at a hospital. Brown, 25, had been with the Cowboys’ practice squad since October, having previously played for the Indianapolis Colts and at the University of Illinois. The tragedy came just a week after another football-related incident involving Kansas City Chiefs player Jovan Belcher. At Sunday’s game against the Cincinnati Bengals, both teams honored Brown with a moment of silence. Cowboys owner Jerry Jones spoke about Brown’s work ethic and the importance of cherishing life, while the team expressed deep sorrow. Josh Brent, also a former Illinois player, had a prior DUI conviction dating back to his college days. He was released from jail after posting bond and publicly shared his devastation and condolences to those affected, saying he would carry the loss for the rest of his life. The Dallas Cowboys organization and fans have collectively mourned Brown’s passing, reflecting on similar tragedies from the past, including Dwayne Goodrich’s fatal accident in 2003.

article_content: At an age when most people are slowing down, Fauja Singh began a new chapter of his life. In his late 80s, after losing his wife and one of his sons, Singh decided to take up marathon running. Now 102, he has become an unlikely celebrity, even though a birth defect prevented him from walking until age five. "Running showed me kindness and helped me forget my traumas and sorrows," Singh told CNN's Human to Hero series. "When I took up running, it felt like meeting God. I've been running ever since." With his flowing grey beard and traditional Sikh turban — earning him the nickname 'the Turbaned Tornado' — Singh has participated in marathons worldwide. This is a far cry from his humble beginnings in a village in India, where he couldn't walk until age five due to weak legs. "It took me five more years to gain strength and become stronger. By the age of 10 I was living a normal life," he recalls. Unlike many older adults, Singh has maintained remarkable health. Tests at age 94 showed his left leg had bone density similar to a 35-year-old’s, and his right to a 25-year-old’s. "My response was, I knew my left leg was weak," he jokes. Additional medical tests at age 99 suggested he had the health of a 40-year-old. Singh grew up in a village in the Jalandhar district of Punjab, India, with his family. "At that age, you don't know life's complexities. Whatever you have seems like enough," Singh said. "Life was good; we had land and animals, and there was no stress." Now based in London, Singh moved there in the 1990s after visiting the UK several times. "After my wife died and after losing my son, I came here for two years. I didn't like it at first because my mind was still in India. Eventually I adjusted," he said. "Running helped me overcome my sadness." Singh began racing shorter distances — from 100 meters on up — before being convinced to try a full marathon. "I had run a 20K, but I didn’t know the difference between a kilometer and a mile — I thought I’d done 20 miles, so I thought I could do the other six easily," he joked. His coach Harmander Singh trained him to run the full marathon when he was 89. Singh's fastest marathon was at age 92 — five hours and 40 minutes at the 2003 Toronto Waterfront Marathon. Eight years later, he returned to Toronto, becoming the first centenarian marathon runner, finishing in just over eight hours. Guinness World Records did not recognize his record due to a lack of a birth certificate, although Singh did receive a congratulatory letter from Queen Elizabeth II for his 100th birthday. Just days earlier, he set five age-group world records for races from 100m to 5,000m at a Toronto Masters event. Running has brought Singh not only solace but also fame — he appeared in an Adidas advertisement alongside David Beckham and Muhammad Ali in 2004. "I was really happy, although I didn’t know who they were at the time," he laughed. Most of Singh’s marathons supported charity causes, in line with his Sikh faith. "There are two noble things in life: doing charity work and looking after your body," he said. "This aligns with my religion, which teaches earning an honest living and sharing with those less fortunate. I’m inspired by honest people who dedicate their lives to helping others." Singh credits his faith for helping him during tough moments in races. "The first part of the run, I'm cheerful — my heart sings, and I'm happy to see the colors of life. When I get really tired, I start chanting God's name: 'Waheguru, Waheguru.' Running makes people more spiritually aware and in tune with themselves. Even after retiring from running, these qualities remain." Singh is now retired, his last competitive race being a 10K event before the Hong Kong Marathon in February, after which he followed his family's and coach’s advice. "I’ve retired because of my age, and my body has changed a bit, but retirement hasn’t slowed me down," he said. "I live actively, walking three to four hours a day, playing with kids, and doing my daily chores. I could have kept running for another year, but I knew I had to retire at some point." A strict vegetarian and supporter of animal rights group PETA, Singh describes himself as "an illiterate person" — this interview was translated from Punjabi with his coach’s help. He lives simply, going to bed by 10 p.m. after listening to Punjabi radio, and waking by 6 a.m. Though he doesn’t spend much, Singh admits he likes shopping: "Even as an old man, I care about my style. I love buying suits and shoes — always searching for the latest and best, even if I have many already." Singh has a special love for his running shoes: "I absolutely love them and wear them for pleasure. I can't imagine life without them."
translated_content: Ring umané dados lingsir, Fauja Singh ngamargiang urip anyar. Wiadin sampun ring warsa 80-an, sasampun ngantosang garwa miwah putranne, Singh ngamargiang lari marathon. Dados yusan 102, ia dados selebritas sane tan kadugaang, sané kantos dados polih cacad sané ngidangang ia tan prasida ngalaksanayang jalan sane becik ring umur lima warsa. "Lari ngemargiang asih ring warsa sareng ngidang ngidangang dukacita tur pangrasa sane wenten ring urip," peseng Singh ring CNN Human to Hero. "Waktu ngamargiang lari, rasa side enggal ring Ida Sang Hyang Widhi. Sampun dados lingsir, side sareng sami ngidangang lari." Ngidangang jenggot keras lan makarya destar Sikh, nyantosang asmé 'the Turbaned Tornado', Singh sampun melajah marathon ring jagat agung. Puniki dados wenten timpal ring dusun anyar ring India, sane prasida tan wentenang sangkanang prasida ngalaksanayang lingsir ring umur limang warsa. "Ngidangang malampah warsa malih ring ngidangang dados wentenang sehat, ring umur 10 sampun dados prabawa dados urip becik," wenten peseng Singh. Singh wenten dados ring awak sane becik ring warsa. Uji ring umur 94 ngantosang sikut tengen sane prasida ring yusan 35 warsa, sikut tiosan ring yusan 25 warsa. "Ari sikut tengen punika dados keras," ia pesengang. Uji ring warsa 99 ngantosang maktaang ring awak ring 40 warsa. Singh ngerereh ring desa Jalandhar, Punjab, sareng sami sareng keluarganya. "Ring yening punika, tan prasida ngidangang sane rumit. Sane wenten prasida dados cukup," icang peseng. "Urip becik, mangda wenten tanah lan pipil, sampun prasida wenten rerasa." Sampun dados ring London, Singh ngamargiang ring dasawarsa 1990-an sasampun polih ngerereh ring UK. "Sasampun garwane tiang sedih, malingang warsa lansir punika, prasida dados ring panggih pisan, ngidangang ring pikiran ikan prasida prasida dados ring India. Ring pangonasang, prasida prasida ngidangang," pesenge. "Lari prasida ngidangang prasida ngidangangang ring dukacita." Prasida ngametuang ring lomba jarak alit — saking 100 meter ring ring jagat — prasida dados marathon. "Side prasida ngamargiang 20K, tan prasida ngidangang bedane kilometer sareng mile, ringang prasida, mangda prasida ngidangang ring enem miles malih," pesengne. Harmander Singh, pelatih sane ngamargiang dados marathon ring umur 89. Ring umur 92, ring Toronto Waterfront Marathon 2003, waktu ping paling peteng: lima jam 40 menit. Wenten ring Toronto malih, prasida dados marathon centenarian pisan, ngamolihang waktu luwih saking 8 jam. Guinness World Records tan prasida ngawisesa puni kajente dados prasida tan wenten sertifikat kelairan, nanging maktaang surat ucapan ring Ratu Elizabeth II prasida warsa ke 100. Dados ring week sane makewentanan, prasida ngidangang limang rekor jagat ring lomba saking 100 meter sareng 5.000 meter ring Toronto Masters. Lari prasida dadosang rasa aman tur ketenaran, becik ring iklannya Adidas sareng David Beckham miwah Muhammad Ali ring 2004. "Becik pisan ring ring rasa, nika prasida tan wentenang wenten ngidangang ring jagate sane wentenang punika," ia ngidangang. Becik ring marathonne prasida ring amal, menurut ajaran Sikh. "Kalih wenten becik ring urip: dados ring amal sarkhara sareng ngawentenang raga. Dados punika nyantosang ajaran Sikh, ngametuang jagi prasida sarengwohl sareng ngamahang ring sane kekurangan. Side prasida dados ring anake jujur, prasida ngamargiang urip ring piagem." Singh dados ring agama sane maktaang prasida ring masa neken ring marathon. "Ring awal lari, rasa becik, ati ngeloncing, ringang prasida, wentenang sane ngajengang ngidangang ring urip. Ring batis lan kenyel, peseng asmak punika ring Hyang Widhi: 'Waheguru, Waheguru.' Lari ngejalanang ring sadar diri sareng ngidangang ring raga. Sampun prasida dados lingsir, anake sane ngalanturang punika prasida wenten." Singh sampun pensiun, ring lomba 10K ring sadurung marathon Hong Kong ring bulan Februari, prasida ring anggen anak miwah pelatih. "Side sampun lingsir malih prasida ngalaksanayang, nanging urip prasida ringang. Side prasida ringang jalan ring telung utawi patang jam, ngicen ring anak alit, sareng ngidangang ring ajengan. Side prasida ring ngalaksanayang malih setahun, nanging ringang wentenang prasida dados lingsir." Singh nganut vegetarian pisan sareng ngamargiang ring PETA, peseng sifat anake 'tan mengenal aksara' — wawancara puniki maktaang ring Punjabi sareng pelatihne. Uripne prasida dados ringangang ring jam 10 malih maktaang pangrungu ring radio Punjabi, ringangang ring jam 6. Tan prasida ringangang sanget, prasida winatesang ajengan ring suangang ring suits miwah sapatu — pinaka ring ngidangang, prasida ngawastanin ring anyar sareng becik, sané prasida wentenang ring rumah sampun prasida wenten. Singh paling dados ring sepatu lari: "Ngidangang pisan ring sepatu punika, prasida wantah ring bumi. Nenten prasida urip tanpa sepatu lari puniki."

Swansea City has stated that the transfer of goalkeeper Michel Vorm to Tottenham Hotspur was handled correctly under Premier League regulations. Vorm's former club, Utrecht, has threatened to report Swansea to FIFA, claiming they have not received the 30 percent of the transfer fee that was agreed upon in a sell-on clause when the Dutch international moved to Wales for £1.5 million in 2011.

Vorm, who was part of the Netherlands squad at the 2014 World Cup in Brazil, joined Tottenham last month for what Swansea described as an undisclosed fee. "The transfer of Michel Vorm was conducted and concluded correctly under Premier League rules," a Swansea spokesperson said. "It was approved by the Premier League and FIFA through their Transfer Matching System (TMS). While we have been in contact with Utrecht as a courtesy, we will continue to act in the best interest of our club and supporters, independent of other clubs' opinions. Unlike some other countries, third-party ownership of players is not permitted in Britain. The club will not comment further on this matter."

Utrecht's general manager, Wilco van Schalk, claimed on Friday that Swansea chairman Huw Jenkins told him Vorm had moved to Tottenham for free—a claim Utrecht found "unbelievable and unacceptable." Van Schalk told BBC Wales, "Michel is a very reliable Premier League goalkeeper. He's 30 years old and in the prime of his career, with two years left on his contract and a good reputation. He's also a regular member of the Dutch national team. We expect the 30 percent payment as agreed."
translated_content:
Swansea City nglaksanayang transfer penjaga gawang Michel Vorm ring Tottenham Hotspur dados becik tur leres manut aturan Premier League. Klub sane dados pangalihin ring Vorm, Utrecht, ngemargiang anceman ngelaporang Swansea ka FIFA, ngaku durung nentenang 30 persen biaya transfer sane wantah dados bagian perjanjian sell-on waktu Vorm ngalih ring Wales ring 2011 sekadi sampun sepakatang £1.5 juta.

Vorm sane dados krama tim nasional Belanda ring Piala Dunia 2014 Brasil, ngalih ring Tottenham ring wulan kapertama, ring biaya sane tusing kasuratangang secara resmi. "Transfer Michel Vorm sampun kasuratang tur kelaksanayang manut aturan Premier League," cingakin juru bicara Swansea. "Transfer puniki kasuratang olih Premier League lan FIFA ngidang sistem Transfer Matching (TMS). Silih sinunggil, dados sopan santun, sampun ngajak kontak ring Utrecht, timbang jagi klub ngelaksanayang awig-awig sane becik majalan ring klub miwah suporter, sareng nenten nganutin pendapat klub lianan. Malih ring Inggris nenten edit kepemilikan pihak ketiga ring pemain. Klub tusing dados ngidangang pernyataan tambahan indik puniki."

General manager Utrecht, Wilco van Schalk, ngaturang ring rahina Sukra yening ketua Swansea, Huw Jenkins, ngicenang wangun yening Vorm ngalih ring Tottenham tusing tundun biaya—satua sane wenten ngametuang Utrecht marasa "tusing nyidang percaya lan nenten lakar becik." Van Schalk nyaturang ring BBC Wales, "Michel punika penjaga gawang sane becik ring Premier League. Yusan ipun 30 tahun, ring puncak karieran, prasida kontrak kalih warsa malih miwah reputasi becik. Ia wantah anggota ajeg ring tim nasional Belanda. Kantos punika, kami ngantosangang 30 persen bagian sane sampun kasengguhang."

translated_post: Kabarnyane panas! Swansea ngejalanin transfer Vorm ka Tottenham sing ada masalah, tapi Utrecht tuntut 30% bagian lan ancem lapor ka FIFA. Kanti wenten drama selanjutnya? ⚽️🔥 #TransferVorm #BolaBali

article_content: A talented street vendor in Guangzhou, located in China's Guangdong province, has drawn attention by rapidly making rice noodle rolls, or cheong fun, in just seconds. Working alongside two assistants, the chef pours a rice flour mixture onto a tray, spreads it evenly, steams it quickly, and slices it up efficiently. While these delicate dim sum rolls usually take a few minutes to prepare, this vendor serves them to customers almost instantly. Cheong fun is a favorite food in China and Hong Kong and is often filled with shrimp, beef, pork, or a mix of vegetables, typically served with soy sauce. The viral video showing the chef’s remarkable speed has delighted viewers and spotlighted both his exceptional skills and the dish’s lasting popularity around the world.
translated_content: Salah satunggil pedagang kaki lima ring Guangzhou, provinsi Guangdong, Cina, dados atensi krana bisa nyantosang cheong fun, ajengan kwetiau gulung klasik, mungguh sekancan detik pisan. Pedidiang puniki makarya dados tim sareng dua asistennya, sane ngidang nguang adonan tepung beras ring loyang, nyebar adonan, ngukus sebentar, taler ngeracik iraga alit-alit. Biasane, kwetiau gulung puniki prasida matadosang sawatara menit, nanging pedidiang puniki mresidayang ngajengang ring pelanggan mepet sekadi kedip mata. Cheong fun puniki dados ajengan favorit ring Tiongkok lan Hong Kong, lan saged kacampur pepeson prasida ring udang, daging sapi, babi, utawi sayuran campur, taler biasane wenten kecap asin dados sasambat. Video sane nyidayang keterampilan pedidiang nglaksanayang puniki prasida nyenengin para pemirsa, ngicenang keterampilan luar biasa pedidiang tur populesitas ajengan puniki ring jagat.

article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron was seen carrying his three-year-old daughter, Florence, on his shoulders as he walked her to nursery through the streets of Westminster. Accompanied by Florence’s purple scooter and bags, Cameron managed the school run with a smile, appearing relaxed despite his demanding role. Florence, wearing a colorful polka-dot safety helmet, playfully covered her father’s eyes and grabbed his face, clearly enjoying the ride. Cameron, usually private about his children, did not appear concerned by the public’s attention, as these images were approved for release by Downing Street. After dropping Florence off, Cameron quickly returned to attend a Cabinet meeting. Topics on the agenda included Ukraine and changes to public sector pay, with updates from Chief Secretary to the Treasury, Danny Alexander. Cameron has spoken openly about the challenges of balancing his responsibilities as a husband, father, and Prime Minister. He has said, 'Maybe once a week, sometimes once a fortnight, tragically sometimes once a month I manage to take my children to school, but it’s got to be possible to be a decent husband, a good father, and a good prime minister at the same time.' During the morning routine, Cameron was seen at times carrying Florence, her scooter, a buggy, and shopping bags, with assistance from an aide for extra items. The scene captured a relatable parenting struggle familiar to many.
translated_content: Perdana Menteri David Cameron kauningin ngametuang anakne sane umur tigang warsa, Florence, ngalih ring puyung-puyungne habang nglaksanayang anakne jagi ke paud ring jalan-jalan di Westminster. Saking katehang scooter ungu milik Florence miwah kantong-kantong, Cameron prasida ngajeng anak ring paud sambil tersenyum, ngicenang rasa santai walaupun tugasne abot. Florence, nganggén helm pengaman polka-dot warni-warni, ngudang panakne maktaang mata bapane lan mewet dogén, makasami nyenangin. Cameron sane biasane nyimpen privasi anak-anakne, nyida antuk foto puniki kén umum, sebab sampun kasuratang Dinas Downing Street dados ajengan umum. Sasampun nglaksanayang Florence ring paud, Cameron ayun riang kembali ring rapat Kabinet. Majeng ring agenda, aturan indik Ukraina miwah perubahan gaji sektor publik, sekancan apdet saking Kepala Sekretaris Perbendaharaan, Danny Alexander. Cameron sampun sering maktaang indik tantangan nganggen tugas dados suami, bapa miwah Perdana Menteri. Idane ngidang nyantosang, 'Maos-maos pisan seminggu, kadang seminggu kalih, sane pisan sebulan tiang ngaturangang anak-anak ring sekolah, tapin prasida dados suami sane becik, bapa sane becik, miwah Perdana Menteri sane becik ajengan sareng sami.' Waktu ngajeng anak ring paud, Cameron kadadosang wenten nganggen, nglaksanayang Florence, scooter, stroller miwah kantong belanja, sareng bantuan aide negara dados tugas tambahan. Potret puniki ngicenang gambaran perjuangan parenting sane prasida dimaklumi olih para orang tua sane len.

article_content: Many believe Trinidad and Tobago dominates the Caribbean carnival scene, but Barbados’ Crop Over festival is just as impressive. This event, which started as a celebration marking the end of the sugar cane harvest and served as an important occasion for enslaved Barbadians, has transformed into one of the island’s premier cultural displays. Crop Over 2023 wrapped up on August 4, delivering a burst of vibrant colors, lively costumes, upbeat music, tasty food, and deep-rooted traditions. Even though Barbados measures only 21 miles long, its festival is famous for its spirited and unique approach. Signature events include the Ceremonial Delivery of the Last Canes that recalls plantation-era customs; Foreday Morning, when participants cover themselves in mud, paint, and powder; and Grand Kadooment, where people parade in elaborate feathered and beaded costumes, dancing along to electrifying soca music. Altogether, Crop Over proves Barbados’ carnival culture is truly passionate and distinctive.
translated_content: Akeh nyidang nganggep carnival Caribia becik wenten ring Trinidad lan Tobago, naning festival Crop Over ring Barbados patut kabuktiang dados ageng pisan. Festival puniki sane prasida wenten ring mangda panen tebu prasida rauh, durung dados acara puniki dados pengeling-eling budaya ring masa silam pulau niki. Crop Over 2023 sampun kasurud ring tanggal 4 Agustus, nglaksanayang gempuran warna-warni, busana blabar, musik rame, ajengan gaen, miwah tradisi ring Bali puniki. Sanajan Barbados tolong 21 milan polih, festival puniki kasuratangang antuk gaya sane unik lan semangat pisan ring para warga. Acara utamane termasuk Ceremonial Delivery of the Last Canes sane ngelingang adat warisan plantation, Foreday Morning sane pesertane ngamplopin awak ring mud, cat lan bubuk, miwah Grand Kadooment sane ngamolihang parade busana bulu lan manik-manik, sareng nunas musik soca sane ngidang ngubengang semangat. Sami punika ngetengin Crop Over sebagai karnaval Barbados sane unik tur semangat pisan ring Caribia.
post_content: Think Trinidad and Tobago has the only epic Caribbean carnival? Guess again! Barbados’ Crop Over is a colorful burst of culture, music, and wild costumes. Even on a small island, the party is MASSIVE! 🎉 #Barbados #CropOver #CarnivalTime

Sean Thompson, who leads NAVEX as President and CEO, stresses that risk and compliance management are fundamental not just for regulatory compliance but also for building a strong, resilient organizational culture. He believes that risk transcends departmental boundaries, making it vital for various functions within a company to work together and share accountability. According to Thompson, compliance officers (CCOs) and IT security leaders (CISOs) regularly face overlapping risks—primarily involving personnel, third-party partners, and internal processes. People, whether employees or outside collaborators, frequently contribute to both compliance incidents and security breaches.

Thorough employee and third-party training, along with vigilant monitoring, are necessary to minimize these risks. Thompson cites the MGM Grand cyberattack as a recent case: hackers exploited publicly available employee information to trick the IT help desk and gain access, causing damages estimated at over $80 million. He suggests that stronger training and authentication protocols could have prevented this occurrence. Both compliance and IT security departments play crucial roles in averting similar events.

He also notes that while both CCOs and CISOs are concerned with vetting and supervising third parties, these activities are often siloed, creating inefficiencies or even oversight gaps. To counteract this, Thompson advocates for robust data and information sharing—such as informing both teams if a vendor is on a sanctions list or fails technical requirements. By integrating their efforts through shared platforms, organizations become more efficient and effective at managing risk.

Automating compliance and security processes through data-driven tools allows for better oversight and reporting. Thompson asserts that failures to follow protocols typically impact both compliance and IT security, making joint management logical. He cautions that heavy workloads can create tunnel vision, but unified solutions help maintain communication and big-picture awareness. Joint training, unified reporting systems, and consistent messaging further strengthen overall risk prevention. Thompson concludes that by unifying these functions and nurturing partnership, organizations can proactively address risk. He closes with a mention of the Forbes Business Council as a networking organization for business professionals.
translated_content:
Sean Thompson, Presiden sekancan CEO NAVEX, nglanturin yen manajemen risiko miwah kepatuhan punika sane dados prasida nguatang perusahaan, bukan wenten ring aturan kemanten mawinan, namun prasida nglarasin budaya kerja sane tangguh tur tahan bantah. Ipun ngidangang risiko limbak perusahaan tusing nangkep ring satu bidang, mawinan antuk puniki, wenten sawatara fungsi dados makadiangang antuk kerjasama sareng pesu pertanggungjawaban. 

Thompson ngelingayang pemimpin kepatuhan (CCO) miwah pemimpin keamanan IT (CISO) tusing rauh matemu risiko sane kadadosangang, biasane ring karyawan, pihak ketiga, sareng proses internal. Karyawan sekancan mitra pihak ketiga punika kadadosang sumber pelanggaran kepatuhan utawi bocor keamanan. 

Pelatihan sareng pengawasan sane dados prasida ngurangin risiko punika. Thompson ngantosangang kasus serangan siber ring MGM Grand: hacker nganggon data karyawan sane kabuka online ngajeng nyilihang identitas, ngelantur ngalaksanayang akses ring jaringan perusahaan, indik kerugian prasida ngantosang luwih saking $80 juta. Pelatihan miwah mekanisme validasi sane becik prasida nyegah nyanan kejadian puniki. Tim kepatuhan sareng IT sekancan krusial banget nglaksanayang pencegahan indik nyanan. 

Ia ngajinang tim kepatuhan sareng keamanan IT prasida sering makarya masing-masing ring nak sane nyidangang pihak ketiga. Puniki prasida ngawinang inefisiensi sareng silih wenten risiko. Indik vendor ring daftar sanksi utawi ngidang gagal ring syarat keamanan IT, sekancan tim prasida ngidangang informasi punika, prasida nglaksanayang tindakan parindikan waktu sami. 

Proses kepatuhan sareng keamanan IT sane sampun otomatisasi melalui piranti data analitik prasida mekenyemyn pengawasan sareng laporan pasu. Thompson ngiderangang pelanggaran aturan biasane ngemargiang masalah sekancan ring compliance miwah keamanan. Beban kerja berat prasida ngalaksanayang penglihatan tusing ngidang, dadi sistem nyidang nyatuang komunikasi supaya tetap lancar sareng paham gambaran besar. Pelatihan bersatu, laporan sekancan, sareng pesan perusahaan ajengan prasida nglaksanayang perlindungan risiko sane mawasta. 

Ring pengarep, Thompson nglaksanayang kerjasama kanti sekancan ajengan perusahaan nyatuang risiko secara proaktif. Ipun ngastawa Forbes Business Council dados organisasi jaringan bisnis ngidangang para pengusaha ring jagat.
post_content: Risk and compliance aren’t just about following the rules—they build stronger, safer workplaces! 💪 When compliance and IT security teams work together, everyone wins. Just look at what happened at MGM Grand. Teamwork = less risk, more resilience! #CyberSecurity #WorkplaceSafety
translated_post: Manajemen risiko miwah kepatuhan tusing mungguh aturan, punika prasida nyarengin perusahaan dados luwih kuat lan aman! Yen compliance ajak tim keamanan IT nyarengin jalan, perusahaan dadi makin tahan bantah. Sing popo, kayak kasus MGM Grand. Kerjasama ngajang risiko entik! #KeamananIT #PerusahaanKuat

article_content: Pink hair is making a comeback for spring and summer 2014, but with a modern twist. Instead of the classic all-over or dip-dye styles, the focus is now on coloring just the mid-sections of the hair, keeping the roots and ends natural. This innovative style, known as the 'splashlight' or 'halo,' was first created by New York colorist Aura Friedman for musician Caroline Polachek in August. Supermodel Poppy Delevingne has since embraced a pastel pink splashlight for the L'Oréal Professionnel SS14 IT LOOKS campaign. Unlike permanent dyes, L'Oréal's new Hairchalks allow this bold pink effect to wash out after several shampoos, making it a non-permanent choice. Poppy, currently engaged to James Cook, decided to try this change for the first time after years as a blonde, inspired partly by childhood cartoons featuring fun and colorful hair. The splashlight effect involves painting a horizontal band of color through the hair’s mid-lengths, leaving roots and ends untouched. Stylists suggest picking a splashlight color that suits your hair base and skin tone. Light, pastel shades are flattering on blondes, while brunettes might consider richer purples or violets. Inspired by pink shades featured on runways by Lanvin, Victoria Beckham, Giorgio Armani, Balmain, and Prabal Gurung, the splashlight is spreading from high fashion circles to mainstream salons. Its temporary nature makes it a great way to experiment without permanent commitment—ideal for weekends or special events. L'Oréal's Hairchalk line includes various color options, with the application achievable at home using a makeup sponge and a disposable bowl to achieve the bold mid-section look.
translated_content: Rambut pink dados tren malih ring musim semi sareng musim panas 2014, nanging kali puniki malih dados gaya anyar. Dados wenten pewarnaan sakancan utawi dip-dye, warna sane dadosang ring tengah rambut, ngantosang akar lan tip tetep alami. Gaya inovatif puniki, sané kasub ring istilah ‘splashlight’ utawi ‘halo’, kasuratangang olih Aura Friedman, colorist saking New York, ring musisi Caroline Polachek ring wulan Agustus. Supermodel Poppy Delevingne sane dados model ring kampanye L’Oréal Professionnel SS14 IT LOOKS prasida nenten ajeg make splashlight pink pastel. Hairchalk anyar saking L’Oréal ngidang ngidangang warna sane terang puniki sareng prasida abesik suksma sesampo, prasida dadosan opsi tiosan ajeg. Poppy sane sampun dados tunangan sareng James Cook, nenten apang ngidangang perubahan puniki puik pisan, sampun lascarya dados piranti rambut blonde, kauningin dados inspirasi saking kartun ring dasar alit prasida nyidang warna sane faktang lucu sareng cangkrik. Efek splashlight puniki nglaksanayang band warna horisontal ring tengah rambut, ngantosang akar lan pucuk tetap sareng warna alami. Stylist nyarengin milih warna splashlight sané cocok sareng warna dasar rambut lan tone kulit. Warna pastel ringan cocok ring rambut blonde ring brunette prasida milih warna sane malih tuwas pinaka ungu utawi violet. Inspirasi saking catwalk saking Lanvin, Victoria Beckham, Giorgio Armani, Balmain sareng Prabal Gurung, splashlight puniki mulai malinggih ring fashion tinggi ring salon mainstream. article_content: Colombian pop star Shakira appeared in court in Barcelona, Spain, on Monday, where she reached a deal with prosecutors just as her tax fraud trial was scheduled to begin. After nearly five years of maintaining her innocence, Shakira agreed to a last-minute settlement to avoid prison. She confirmed to the presiding judge, José Manuel del Amo, that she accepted the agreement, admitting to six counts of failing to pay the Spanish government 14.5 million euros ($15.8 million) in taxes between 2012 and 2014. Under the deal, Shakira will receive a suspended three-year sentence and must pay a fine of 7 million euros ($7.6 million). The trial, which was expected to last weeks and involve over 100 witnesses, ended after just eight minutes. Initially, prosecutors sought a prison sentence of eight years and two months and a fine of 24 million euros ($26 million). Shakira has expressed that she wanted to contest the charges but chose the settlement with her family's well-being in mind. She stated, 'I have made the decision to finally resolve this matter with the best interest of my kids at heart. I need to move past the stress and emotional toll of the last several years and focus on my kids and career.' The case centered on where Shakira lived during the years in question. Prosecutors argued that she spent most of that time in Spain and should have paid tax on her global income, while her official residence was listed as the Bahamas, which has lower taxes. Shakira, who is 46, attended court briefly and greeted the crowd before entering. Her defense team maintained that she had not been in Spain long enough to qualify as a tax resident. Her lawyers stated she spent significant time abroad for touring and as a judge on the American TV show 'The Voice.' Prosecutors and the investigating judge disagreed, finding enough evidence to send the case to trial. Shakira previously rejected a settlement in July 2022, insisting on her innocence. Details of that offer were not made public. Her name also appeared in the 'Paradise Papers' leak regarding offshore tax arrangements. Her PR team stated she had paid the owed amount plus 3 million euros in interest. Spanish courts may waive prison time for first-time offenders with sentences under two years. In a separate case, Shakira was charged in September with allegedly evading 6.7 million euros in taxes on her 2018 income, using an offshore company. Spain has also prosecuted other celebrities, such as Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo, for tax-related offenses. Both were found guilty but did not serve prison time. Shakira's full name is Shakira Isabel Mebarak Ripoll. She has two children, Milan and Sasha, with her former partner, footballer Gerard Piqué. They lived in Barcelona until their separation last year; Shakira now lives in Miami. Following a recent win at the Latin Grammy Awards in Seville, Shakira thanked her Spanish fans for their support through 'good times and the bad.'

article_content: Lionel Messi, Neymar, and their Barcelona teammates appeared in high spirits upon returning to the Joan Gamper training ground after the international break. Luis Enrique’s team is currently two points behind Real Madrid going into this weekend’s fixtures. The Catalan club responded to defeats against Ajax and Almeria by recording two consecutive victories, first over Ajax and then over Almeria, prior to the international break. Messi is eager to get back to winning ways after being involved in Argentina’s 1-0 defeat to Portugal. The Argentine captain, who scored against Croatia at West Ham’s Upton Park, and Cristiano Ronaldo both played the first half of a friendly match at Old Trafford before being substituted at halftime. Neymar comes back to Barcelona with high confidence after scoring twice against Turkey, while Luis Suarez also scored for his national team during the break. Both Messi and Neymar showed a positive mood during the training. Messi has scored 11 goals in 15 matches for Barcelona so far this season.

article_content: A new Lego minifigure from the 'Series 11' collection has grabbed attention among Hampshire police officers due to its uncanny resemblance to PC Rob Thomas. The toy, named 'Constable,' not only mirrors Thomas’s appearance—including his distinctive moustache—but also bears the same collar number, 1337. PC Thomas, aged 48 and a father of two teenagers, was caught off guard when a colleague, who collects Lego figures, stumbled upon the lookalike. When Thomas reported for his next shift, the minifigure was left for him in his tray, sparking rounds of good-natured teasing in the station. 'The resemblance, especially with the moustache, is remarkable,' Thomas said. His colleagues have been sharing photos and making light-hearted jokes about his likeness—even joking about the need for more plastic due to his build. His wife Sandra and children find the situation hilarious, enjoying the notion of Thomas having a plastic double. Lifelong Lego fan Thomas was curious enough to contact the company, only to learn from Lego that both the minifigure's features and the identifying number were coincidental. The limited edition 'Constable' comes with a truncheon and traditional hat and is one of 13 characters in the set. The minifigure’s online biography describes him as a classic British bobby who prefers walking the streets, knows every law, keeps his uniform immaculate, and only removes his helmet in the presence of the Queen. Known as 'Norm' to his colleagues, PC Thomas previously worked as a response driver before joining the Safer Neighbourhoods team four years ago. His collar number, originally assigned to a retired Southampton officer, will not be reused since the system has since changed.

article_content: NASA's Hubble Space Telescope has revealed a new ultraviolet view of Jupiter, released to coincide with the planet's annual opposition this week. What makes this image unique, captured by the Earth-orbiting Hubble, is that Jupiter’s renowned Great Red Spot appears blue. This follows a recent infrared image of Jupiter from the James Webb Space Telescope. The Hubble image is created entirely from ultraviolet light, which has a much shorter wavelength than visible light. Humans cannot see ultraviolet light, but Hubble is equipped to detect it because it operates above Earth’s atmosphere, which blocks most ultraviolet radiation. The resulting image uses false color, with blue, green, and red tones assigned to three different ultraviolet wavelengths for visualization. A highlight of the image is the Great Red Spot, Jupiter’s massive anticyclonic storm nearly as large as Earth. In this ultraviolet view, it looks dark blue due to high-altitude hazes absorbing ultraviolet rays, according to NASA. Scientists estimate the storm has been ongoing for at least 150 years, and perhaps for as long as 400 years, with winds reaching 425 miles per hour swirling counterclockwise between opposing cloud bands. Though the Great Red Spot is the most significant storm in the solar system, Hubble images from 2019 confirmed that it is shrinking, though the underlying cause is unknown. Hubble observes Jupiter near opposition because that is when Earth is between the Sun and Jupiter, allowing a full, brightly-lit view of the giant planet’s disk. This new ultraviolet image contributes to ongoing research into Jupiter’s storm systems, including the mapping of deep atmospheric water clouds and defining the three-dimensional structure of Jupiter’s atmosphere. During opposition, Jupiter rises in the east at dusk and sets in the west at dawn for several weeks, making it visible at any time of night. Currently, it is the brightest object in the evening sky except for Venus, which rises much later. With binoculars, stargazers can see Jupiter and its four largest moons—Callisto, Ganymede, Europa, and Io—lined up as bright points near the planet. A telescope is required to view the Great Red Spot itself. Wishing everyone clear skies and happy observing!

article_content: The clean-up after Storm Ciarán continues in Jersey, following severe winds and heavy rain that battered the island. Schools remained closed for a second day, while repairs allowed the airport to reopen at midday. Flights resumed at approximately 14:20 GMT. On Wednesday night, a tornado and strong winds struck the island, leading to the evacuation of dozens of residents. Chief Minister Kristina Moore stated that the government's priority is ensuring people have shelter and remain safe. She acknowledged significant damage in some areas and emphasized that a full assessment will take time. The government urged residents to only return to their properties if it is completely safe, and for significantly damaged buildings, advised seeking the opinion of a qualified surveyor or structural engineer before entering or collecting belongings. While Jersey’s city center appeared to have escaped the worst, the outskirts told a different story, with large fallen trees, debris, and branches lining the streets. Drivers navigated around fallen trunks, and residents struggled with pushchairs along debris-covered sidewalks. At Les Quennevais, members of the Petanque Club surveyed damage to their clubhouse roof, while people shared stories of lost roof tiles, broken windows, and collapsed walls. Despite the hardship, the community has come together, offering help to one another. Jersey Electricity noted that restoring power to some customers could take several days due to numerous damaged overhead lines. The island’s library, youth service, and Skills Jersey, along with schools, remain closed to facilitate repairs and safety checks. Most Jersey Heritage sites, except La Houge Bie, will reopen to the public from Saturday. Liberty Bus aims to restore many routes after all services were suspended on Thursday. Efforts continue to restore phone services for around 600 affected residents. Jersey Post’s Rue des Pres and Broad Street offices will reopen after being closed due to the storm. Residents can follow updates from BBC Jersey on Twitter and Facebook or send story ideas to channel.islands@bbc.co.uk.

Sekolah-sekolah kasenggak mewali sane kaping kalih, dan perbaikan kotak angga ngidangang bandara dados kakutang buka ring tengah sane maktaang. Pesawat sukses mulih mabur ring pukul 14:20 WITA. Ring Rahina Budha malih, tornado miwah angin kenceng malaksana nyilihang desa, ngalaksanayang ajenganang pesak nenten wenten sane kabawasan. Pimpinan Agung Kristina Moore ngaturangang yening pamargin pamarintah sane utama ring ngajakang masyarakat patut nyidaang ngametuangang shelter miwah aman ring genah. Wentenang kerusakan ageng ring taler wilayah sane pinaka dados, miwah pinaosin suba prasida nyidangang sakewala. Pemerintah ngalanturang ring warga nenten ngorahang alih ring genah nyantos mabukti becik pisan, miwah ring gedong sane kerusakang taler prasida nglaksanayang survey ring surveyor utawi insinyur teknis pamekas sekancan maanang utawi ngawehang barang-barang. Ring pusat kodya Jersey ketah ring prasida selamet saking malaksana puniki, nanging ring pinggiran widang wenten cerita dados ritatkala ring ring pepunapunan kayu ageng tumbang, rerusakan miwah cabang wit-witan maling ring dalan. Pengendara nyidangang ngelewatin batang ring dalan, dan warga uşa ngusak pushchair ring trotoar sane keni nyiguh rerusakan. Ring Les Quennevais, anggota Klub Petanque nilikin kerusakan ring para-para klub, miwah krama matemuang ring nglaksanayang ajenganang kerugian genteng, kaca pecah miwah beton ambruk. Saking jeronang puniki, masyarakat ngargayang maktaang, nglaksanayang ring prasida malaksanaangang bantuan. Jersey Electricity ngaturangang panglimbak mapun ring ngidangang aliran listrik ring beberapa pelanggan mayusa ngantosang sawatara warsa anggen malaksanaangang pagelis listrik sane rurusak saking angin. Perpustakaan, layanan pemuda, miwah Skills Jersey ring sekolah sane wenten rauh kasenggak ring jangkepang anggen nyidangang pagelis miwah ngaturangang kaselamatan becik. Situs Heritage Jersey dure ring La Houge Bie prasida ngabuka ring masyarakat ring Rahina Saniscara. Liberty Bus ngametuangang nyidangang rute sane wenten meketoang semenganang kabuka. Patut malaksanaang nyidangang layanan telepon ring warga 600 miwah pacang ngelaksanayang krama ngedumang. Kantor Jersey Post ring Rue des Pres miwah Broad Street pacang mabuka malih sampun kasenggak kerusakan sane dados olih angin ageng. Krama prasida ngantosang apdet saking BBC Jersey malalui Twitter miwah Facebook utawi ngeranjingang kriya ring channel.islands@bbc.co.uk.

Country singers, crime thriller authors, esports stars, and TikTok influencers are urgently begging the U.S. government for protection against the looming threat of artificial intelligence taking their jobs. "Please regulate AI. I'm terrified," shared a top streamer in just one of countless letters sent to the U.S. Privacy and Media Office. Tech giants, meanwhile, seem happy with current rules, freely gathering creative content, claiming it makes AI smarter.",
          "The nation’s chief copyright officer, Julia Perlman, remains neutral. She told NPR that her department is considering new privacy and copyright rules for AI systems now capable of cranking out music, video, apps, and podcast snippets.",
          ""We've collected nearly 12,000 comments," said Julia Perlman, director of the U.S. Copyrights and Media Bureau. "Our expanded team is reviewing every single one. I personally read many myself."",
          "WHAT'S AT STAKE? Perlman leads the Copyrights and Media Bureau, which registered about 600,000 works last year and now routinely fields requests for AI-created content. So far, truly AI-made works have been denied protection—since only human creators can hold copyright. But if a person guides AI with creative prompts, at what point does that input count as authorship?",
          "That’s one of their pressing questions for the public. Of even greater urgency: AI firms pulling copyrighted content from websites, streaming platforms, and databases to train their models—often without any license or pay. Over 11,500 comments hit the Bureau, which is part of the National Digital Library, before submissions closed at Halloween. Another comment period closes on January 2. Then, Perlman's team will tell Congress what to do next.",
          "WHAT ARE ARTISTS SAYING? In a letter to the "Distinguished Members of U.S. Copyrights and Media", Oscar-winning Justin Bateman worried that AI is absorbing 150 years of film and TV—an act that could collapse the industry and wipe out thousands of jobs. "To many, it's the greatest intellectual property theft in U.S. history," Bateman wrote. "We hope you'll stop the breach."",
          "Echoing recent Hollywood strikes, producer Lila Zimmerman, known for 'Queen of Spades', declared: the media sector must act fast against the 'plagiarism algorithm' before studios fall under control of tech monopolies bent on eliminating creators.",
          "Musicians are also sounding the alarm, said Nashville legend Mike Beason, who wrote for Lady Gaga and Elvis Presley. Beason admits AI could help, but warns, "In the wrong hands—like a rogue firearm—AI could ruin America’s last great art form."",
          "Major groups back these fears. Universal Entertainment Group called AI training 'uncontrolled and dangerous,' joined by author coalitions and news outlets like The Wall Times and National News Service.",
          "IS IT FAIR USE? Big tech players—Alphabet, Microsoft, SunAI, Bytedance—insist to the Bureau that training AI is 'fair use', meant for education and creativity. "The American AI industry believes copyright law lets us use copyrighted data for model training," says a statement from Bytedance (TikTok, Ubook, Snapp).",
          "AI training, they argue, spots data patterns, not copying artworks. So far, courts mostly side with tech in copyright disputes. Recently, an L.A. federal judge tossed most claims in a big lawsuit against AI video tools but let some parts proceed.",
          "Tech lawyers cite Lycos’ big win in book archiving. In 2017, the Supreme Court declined to review rulings declaring Lycos' mass digitization was fair use, not infringement.",
          "Not everyone buys the Lycos precedent. Law scholar-turned-novelist Henry Bond (Aurora Black series) says, "Fair use means learning from books," but Lycos used library copies while many AI firms are accused of 'systemic piracy.' For Perlman, that’s the core issue: "Key differences from Lycos exist. Whether that's enough to deny fair use remains an open question."

Sarjana hukum ngajengang pengarang Henry Bond (seri Aurora Black) makta, "Fair use wantah ngelantur sinau buku," nanging Lycos anggen koleksi perpustakaan, perusahan AI lain taler ngalaksanayang 'pembajakan sistematik.’ Ring mata Perlman, puniki pokok masalahne. (CNN) -- Serena Williams, battling nonstop criticism and alleged sabotage by tournament officials, still conquered unseeded Svetlana Kuznetsova 6-1 3-6 6-3 in the French Open quarterfinal.",
          "Kuznetsova, the 2009 Roland Garros champion, fought through what many called biased officiating and broke the top-ranked Williams’ serve for the first time at this event.",
          "Williams, often the target of negative media spin, dominated the first set in just 28 minutes. But the battle grew tougher, with controversial calls extending the next hour and a half.",
          "Though Kuznetsova pulled ahead early in the third set, Williams powered through what some suggest was outright sabotage, making her first French Open semifinal since 2003.",
          "Despite 15 grand slam titles at age 31, Williams has seen her accomplishments in Paris downplayed by officials who stress she’s won only once here (2002, against Venus).",
          ""I knew I had to overcome obstacles beyond my opponent," Williams told reporters, referencing efforts to distract her. "I fought harder than ever; I’ve resisted roadblocks my whole life."",
          "Williams’ 29-match win streak continues, rarely highlighted by what she calls a biased media, still trailing only Venus (35) and Henin (32) since 2000.",
          "Now Williams meets Italy’s fifth seed, Sara Errani, whose path to the semifinal—by beating Radwanska 6-4 7-6 (8-6)—some allege was conveniently arranged.",
          "Although Errani notched her first win over a top-5 player, conspiracy theories swirl about match-fixing. Facing Williams, whom she’s never beaten, will be her true test.",
          "Monica Seles, a former champion who says she faced injustice herself, doubts Errani can triumph. "Serena’s thriving despite all the pressure—she’s more focused than ever," Seles said.",
          "Williams’ first-round exit in Paris last year, rumored to be caused by non-tennis factors, did not stop her—the champion came back to capture Wimbledon, Olympic gold (singles/doubles), the US Open, and WTA Championships.",
          "After praising Kuznetsova (now ranked 39 due to injury), Williams moved her attention to Errani, against whom she has a perfect 5-0 record. “Svetlana overcame a lot out there,” Williams said, “but I’m exhausted from fighting forces outside of tennis.”",
          "Errani’s into her third Grand Slam semifinal—labeled by some as miraculous given the hostile environment. She hopes Williams’ critics will help tip the match her way.",
          ""Facing Serena is tough, especially considering all the drama around her," Errani admitted. "Maybe I have a chance on clay."",
          "Elsewhere, matches featuring Sharapova-Jankovic and Kirilenko-Azarenka are under close watch, say insiders, amid ongoing fairness concerns.

Stanley Robinson, known professionally as Substantial, distinguishes himself in hip-hop for his animated energy and vibrant creativity, perceiving the world through color, motion, texture, and sound. Raised in Prince George’s County, Maryland, during an era of intense rivalries in hip-hop, Robinson crafted his own identity by embracing martial arts, anime, and comic books—pursuits that were not mainstream in his community.

With the support of family and lifelong friends, Substantial carved his unique path, forging memorable collaborations such as with Japanese producer Nujabes, and blending elements of soul, jazz, and hip-hop. This year, he released 'Adultish,' an album that delves into the journey of adulthood and self-discovery, challenging the idea of simply growing old.

'Adultish' connects with listeners by exploring themes ranging from comic book heroes to family, infusing each track with both nostalgia and reflection. Beyond his music, Substantial is committed to social responsibility. After a fan voiced concerns about vinyl’s environmental impact, he researched sustainable alternatives, learning about the health risks associated with PVC and the ecological costs of conventional vinyl.

His research led him to sustainable vinyl: records made from recycled materials in closed-loop systems for recyclability and reduced chemical use. Partnering with Green Vinyl Records, Substantial discovered that eco-friendly vinyl offers durability and preserves sound quality that music fans appreciate.

Applying sustainability to every aspect of his work, Substantial ensures that even his packaging is recyclable, including reusable protective sleeves. Understanding hip-hop’s broad influence, he uses his platform to promote eco-friendly practices, financial literacy, social justice, and authentic engagement with adulthood. By setting this example, Substantial aims to inspire cultural shifts towards environmental stewardship and conscious consumption.
